title: Senior Accountant – Australian Building Contractor Client (Remote / Philippines-based role reporting to Australian Outso
description:
Senior Accountant – Australian Building Contractor Client (Remote / Philippines-based role reporting to Australian Outsourced CFO)



About the Opportunity



Our client is a well-established Australian building contractor. Our outsourced CFO team is seeking an experienced Senior Accountant based in the Philippines. This is a key finance role providing high-level support to the Australian-based CFO, with full ownership of core accounting processes in a construction environment.



Above-market salary will be offered to the right candidate. $2200 - $2500 depending on the experience



Key Responsibilities

• Perform full sub-ledger reconciliations (all ledgers)

• Manage monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and associated reporting

• Produce contract status and profitability reports, including work-in-progress, cost-to-complete and margin analysis by project

• Produce accurate and timely management reports and ad-hoc reports in JobPac

• Support the Australian CFO with high-quality financial analysis and reporting

• Maintain strong internal controls and ensure compliance with Australian accounting standards and client requirements

• Deliver exceptional service to an Australian-based client team



Essential Criteria

1. CPA (or equivalent professional accounting qualification) – Australian qualification preferred

2. Proven Australian client service experience (essential)

3. Minimum 3–5 years hands-on experience with JobPac software (essential)

4. Advanced Excel skills, including thorough knowledge and practical use of Macros

5. Strong experience in full sub-ledger reconciliations

6. Demonstrated experience in monthly, quarterly and year-end closing and reporting

7. Proven experience preparing contract status and profitability reporting (WIP, cost-to-complete, project margin) in a construction or contracting environment

8. Proven ability to produce ad-hoc reports in JobPac

9. Experience reporting directly to a CFO or senior finance leader (Australian-based preferred)

10. Strong, verifiable references from previous relevant employers



What We Offer

• Above-market salary package

• An exciting opportunity with to  Australian Accounting firm.

• Direct exposure to Australian finance leadership and decision-making

• Opportunity to work in a professional, high-accountability environment



How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter addressing the essential criteria above, along with details of your current salary expectations and availability to 

Only candidates who meet all essential criteria will be considered. Strong references will be required prior to offer.

title: Amazon Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company: Black Voyage (US e-commerce brand)

Location: Remote

Pay: 3-5USD [ / hour (based on experience) + raises for high performers



Quick Highlights

Own and elevate our entire customer support operation — not just answer tickets

Weekly sync 1–2x/week (10:00–11:00 AM Manila time) — no daily night shifts

You'll build and refine the SOPs, templates, and dashboards the team runs on

Direct line to leadership — your calls on tone, escalations, and process will shape the brand's customer experience

About Black Voyage



Black Voyage is a fast-growing US e-commerce brand specializing in premium vacuum compression travel gear. In our first year, we achieved multi-million USD revenue across Amazon and Shopify. Our customers are frequent travelers who care deeply about design, efficiency, and smart packing.



We're a small, fast-moving team that values: clarity, ownership, empathy, and high-quality communication.



Schedule



Flexible hours, with availability for a weekly team sync (1–2x/week) during Manila/Taiwan time 10:00–11:00 AM. In most weeks, you'll receive written priorities after the sync; live attendance may not always be required.



Role Overview



We're hiring a Customer Support Specialist to own the customer experience function end-to-end — not just handling tickets, but building the systems, standards, and (eventually) team that keep our support operation sharp as we scale.



This is not a "follow the script" job. We want someone who can set the standard, catch problems before they escalate, and make judgment calls when situations fall outside SOPs.



Focus Split (Typical)



Customer Support Oversight & Escalation Ownership: ~40–50%

Process, SOPs & Quality Management: ~25–30%

Reporting, Metrics & Dashboards: ~15–20%

Cross-functional Coordination (Ops/Influencer support as needed): ~10%

What You'll Do



1) Customer Support Oversight



Own the customer support inbox/queue end-to-end — response quality, tone, and turnaround time

Personally handle or review the most sensitive, high-risk cases (chargeback threats, angry customers, PR-sensitive situations)

Set and enforce response-time and resolution-quality standards



2) Risk & Escalation Management



Own the escalation process for disputes, chargebacks, and 1-star review threats

Make judgment calls on refund/compensation decisions within approved guidelines, and flag exceptions to the CEO

Identify recurring issues (product, shipping, policy) and proactively raise them before they become bigger problems



3) Process, SOPs & Quality



Build, document, and continuously improve customer support SOPs, macros, and templates

Spot-check ticket quality and provide coaching/feedback as the team grows

Maintain a clean, well-organized knowledge base so answers stay consistent



4) Reporting & Metrics



Track and report on key support metrics (response time, resolution time, CSAT, chargeback rate)

Maintain dashboards and trackers (Google Sheets / Notion) that give leadership a clear view of support health

Surface trends and recommendations based on the data, not just raw numbers



5) Cross-functional Support (as needed)



Coordinate with Operations on order/shipping-related support issues

Support light influencer/creator communication using existing templates and guidelines when needed

Who You Are

Excellent written English (you can switch tone: warm & professional for customers; clear & direct with the team/leadership)

Proven experience owning or managing a customer support function, ideally in e-commerce/DTC

Detail-oriented and structured — comfortable managing volume without dropping threads or letting quality slip

Emotionally intelligent — you can de-escalate, stay calm under pressure, and choose the right level of firmness

A builder, not just an operator — you improve the system, not just execute it

Resourceful problem-solver (you try to find the answer first, then ask smart questions when needed)

Tech-comfortable (Shopify +Amazon + Google Workspace is a plus, but not required)

How to Apply (Single-Step — Please Follow Exactly)



We're looking for candidates with strong attention to detail. Applications that don't follow instructions may be ignored.



 to 
 

with the subject line:

Customer Support Team Assistant



In your
, include ALL 3 items below:



1) Resume

Attach as PDF or share a link.



2) 1–2 Minute Loom Video

Briefly introduce yourself and answer:

"Tell us about a time you had to build or improve a process (not just follow one) at work. What did you do, and what was the result?"



3) Written Exercise (Copy & Paste Answers into the
)



Task A (Customer Support – Chargeback Prevention)

A customer is furious. They
:

"I never received my package! You guys stole my money. Refund me immediately or I'm calling my bank!"

You check tracking and it shows Delivered, with a clear Proof of Delivery (POD) photo showing the package at their front door.

Write your reply.

Goal: De-escalate their anger, show empathy, reduce chargeback risk, provide the POD info, and guide next steps.



Task B (Process/Quality Judgment Call)

You notice that 3 different customers this week have complained about the same issue (e.g., a packaging defect) but each was handled differently by past responses — one got a full refund, one got a partial refund, one got only an apology.

What would you do? Write a short plan (a few sentences) covering: (1) how you'd handle the current cases fairly, and (2) what you'd put in place going forward to prevent inconsistent handling.



Technical Requirements (Must Have)

Reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps)

Backup internet option (mobile hotspot is fine)

Laptop/PC capable of multitasking

Interview Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a single interview. No second-round assignments.

title: Direct Response Video Ads Editor
description:
We are an ambitious and rapidly growing e-commerce brand committed to building a strong presence in the online retail space. As we scale our advertising efforts, we are looking for a skilled and creative Direct Response Video Ads Editor to join our team.



Our marketing strategy relies heavily on compelling video ads designed to convert viewers into buyers. We need someone who understands the psychology of direct response advertising and has the technical skills to produce high-quality, engaging video content that drives results.



You will be working with our marketing team to create impactful video ads using pre-provided B-roll footage. Your ability to craft effective hooks, structure engaging narratives, and utilize AI tools to enhance creativity will be critical to your success. This role requires someone who can not only edit quickly but also deliver content that performs exceptionally well on platforms like Meta Ads.



We are particularly interested in candidates who are motivated to work exclusively with us and contribute to the long-term growth of our brand.



Key Responsibilities:



- Editing direct response video ads using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar apps. Preferably (but not necessary) using only CapCut so that the rest of the team can make small edits if necessary.



- Crafting high-converting video ads with three hooks per video to maximize engagement.



- Utilizing AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas to enhance creativity and delivery.



- Testing all videos on Meta Ads to evaluate performance and refine creative approaches.



- Collaborating with our marketing team to ensure video content aligns with brand messaging and marketing goals.



- Continuously optimizing editing techniques to improve ad performance.



Qualifications & Skills:



- Proven experience editing direct response ads for e-commerce brands.



- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.



- Familiarity with AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas.



- Strong understanding of direct response advertising principles.



- Ability to work quickly and deliver high-quality content under tight deadlines.



- Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a team.



- Motivation to work exclusively for our brand and contribute to its growth.



- We're selling to the Scandinavian countries, as well as USA and UK. So it's important you're familiary with how video ads look and feel in those markets. Think TikTok and Instagram.





Application Process:



- To ensure you have read this listing carefully, please begin your application with the phrase: “I create high-converting video ads.”



In your application, please include the following:



- A brief description of your experience with video editing and direct response ads.



- Links to previous work, especially relevant e-commerce ads.



- Your availability and how quickly you can start.



- Why you are interested in working with our brand specifically.



This is a remote position with flexible hours, and compensation will be determined based on your experience and skill level. We are excited to find a talented individual who is eager to grow with us and consistently deliver outstanding results.



Apply now to join our team and help us take our advertising efforts to the next level.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive 



Location: Remote 

Company: Diversified Group with operations in Australia, China, and Hong Kong 

Industries: Professional Services, Agriculture, Manufacturing 

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent 

Salary: Competitive package commensurate with experience 



About Us 



We are a dynamic and diversified group running three distinct businesses across the Asia-Pacific region: 



- A Professional Accountancy & Advisory Firm with offices in Sydney, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. 



- Strawberry Farms in Victoria and Queensland, Australia. 



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our growing marketing team. The ideal candidate will support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing activities across our businesses. 



This is a hands-on and varied role covering social media, content marketing,
 marketing, lead generation, paid advertising, website marketing, and campaign reporting. 



You will work closely with the Marketing Manager and internal teams to help turn marketing strategies into well-executed campaigns that build brand awareness, generate leads, and support business growth. 



If you are interested in working with international brands across different industries, enjoy both creative and analytical work, and want to develop experience across the full digital marketing mix, we'd love to hear from you. 



Role & Responsibilities:



- The responsibilities of this role are varied and involve both creative and analytical tasks. While experience in several areas is preferred, we are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and eager to develop their skills. 



Key responsibilities include: 



- Support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing campaigns across multiple brands and industries. 



- Manage and grow digital marketing activities across relevant channels, including social media,
, websites, search, and paid advertising. 



- Plan, create, schedule, and coordinate marketing content using content calendars. 



- Assist in developing and implementing digital marketing strategies aligned with each brand's business goals. 



- Create and coordinate social media, website, blog,
, and campaign content. 



- Write engaging marketing copy, including social media captions,
 campaigns, promotional content, landing page copy, and advertisements. 



- Support lead generation activities through digital campaigns, social media,
 marketing, and other relevant channels. 



- Assist with the creation, scheduling, and optimization of
 marketing campaigns and customer communications. 



- Support the management of paid advertising campaigns, particularly on Meta platforms and other relevant channels. 



- Monitor website traffic, campaign activity, audience engagement, leads, and conversions. 



- Track and report on key marketing performance metrics, including website traffic, engagement, leads, conversions,
 performance, and advertising results. 



- Analyze campaign performance and provide insights and recommendations to improve results. 



- Conduct market, competitor, audience, and keyword research to identify marketing opportunities. 



- Support SEO and website content optimization initiatives. 



- Assist with landing pages and other digital assets to improve lead generation and conversion. 



- Test and optimize marketing content, messaging, audiences, creatives, and campaigns based on performance data. 



- Actively stay up to date with digital marketing trends, platform updates, SEO, advertising strategies, and emerging marketing tools. 



- Collaborate with the Marketing Manager, designers, content creators, and other internal teams to ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with brand messaging. 



- Manage multiple campaigns, projects, content schedules, and priorities across the group's different businesses. 



Preferred Skills:



- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. 



- Strong interest and understanding of digital marketing and the customer journey. 



- Experience with social media marketing and content management. 



- Basic understanding of paid advertising platforms, particularly Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. 



- Familiarity with
 marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or similar tools. 



- Basic understanding of SEO, keyword research, and website optimization. 



- Strong copywriting skills with the ability to create engaging and conversion-focused content. 



- Analytical mindset with attention to marketing and campaign performance metrics. 



- Organized and able to manage multiple campaigns, brands, and deadlines. 



- A proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and willingness to learn. 



- Ability to balance creative thinking with data-driven decision-making. 



Requirements:



- 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, social media, content marketing, lead generation, paid advertising, or a related role. 



- Experience supporting or managing digital marketing campaigns across one or more channels. 



- Experience managing social media platforms such as
, Instagram, LinkedIn, or similar channels. 



- Experience creating digital marketing content, including social media posts,
 campaigns, promotional copy, or website content. 



- Basic to intermediate understanding of paid advertising, including audience targeting, ad creatives, campaign setup, and optimization. 



- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics,
 marketing platforms, or similar marketing tools. 



- Basic understanding of SEO principles, keyword research, and content optimization. 



- Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement. 



- Ability to interpret key digital marketing metrics such as engagement, reach, CTR, conversion rate, leads, and campaign performance. 



- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. 



- Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously. 



- Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently in a remote environment. 



- Experience working with multiple brands or industries is an advantage. 



- Experience using Canva, WordPress, Shopify, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools is a plus. 



- Experience working in a remote or distributed team environment is an advantage. 



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not required. 



What We're Looking For:



- We are looking for a hands-on, well-rounded, and commercially minded digital marketer who enjoys turning ideas and strategies into action. 



- The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different areas of digital marketing and can balance creativity with performance. You should be curious about what drives results and willing to continuously test, learn, and improve. 



You should be able to ask not only: 



"How can we make this campaign look good?" 



but also: 



"How can we make this campaign perform better and contribute to awareness, leads, conversions, or business growth?" 



What We Offer:



Diverse Challenge: Escape the monotony of working in a single industry. Apply and develop your digital marketing skills across three distinct businesses in Professional Services, Agriculture, and Manufacturing. 



Broad Marketing Experience: Gain hands-on exposure across social media, content marketing, lead generation,
 marketing, paid advertising, SEO, website optimisation, and analytics. 



Professional Growth: This role reports directly to the Marketing Manager and offers significant opportunities to expand your responsibilities and advance as the companies grow. 



International Exposure: Work with businesses and teams across Australia, China, and Hong Kong. 



Remote Flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the Philippines with a stable internet connection. 



Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary package commensurate with experience, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses. 



Supportive Environment: Work closely with the Marketing Manager and receive support from the wider team and ownership group, with access to the resources needed to succeed. 



How to Apply 



Ready to build something exceptional? Please send your application with the subject line: 



Application: Digital Marketing Executive – [Your Name] 



Your application must include: 



Your updated CV/Resume. 



A cover letter that addresses: 



1. Why you are interested in working as a Digital Marketing Executive across different businesses and industries. 



2. A brief example of a digital marketing campaign you have worked on, including the channels used and key results or learnings. 



3. Your experience across the digital marketing areas most relevant to this role. 



4. Your salary expectation. 



5. Optional but highly valued: Links to your portfolio, LinkedIn profile, relevant campaign examples, or case studies. 



Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. 



We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity in our team.

We are **Ignite Training Co**, a rapidly growing face-to-face personal training business based in Adelaide, Australia. We currently work with over 100 clients across two gym locations and create regular content for Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube.



We're looking for a talented and reliable video editor to help us scale our content output and create engaging videos that educate, entertain and generate leads.



## About The Role



This is a remote part-time position with flexible hours.



You will primarily be editing:



* Instagram Reels

* TikToks

*
 videos

* Client transformation videos

* Educational fitness content

* Behind-the-scenes business content

* Promotional videos and advertisements



Most videos will be short-form content between 15 and 90 seconds.



## Responsibilities



* Edit short-form videos with engaging pacing and storytelling.

* Add captions, transitions, zooms and sound effects where appropriate.

* Source B-roll footage when required.

* Create strong hooks within the first 3 seconds of videos.

* Follow brand guidelines and editing style examples.

* Deliver videos within agreed turnaround times.

* Organise project files and maintain communication regarding progress.



## Requirements



* Previous experience editing short-form social media content.

* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, 
 and
 video trends.

* Proficiency with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar software.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Reliable internet connection.

* Ability to take feedback and implement revisions quickly.

* Attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work.



## Bonus Points If You Have Experience With



* Fitness industry content.

* YouTube editing.

* Motion graphics.

* Thumbnail creation.

* Graphic design.

* AI editing tools and workflows.



## Hours & Pay



* Approximately 10-20 hours per week initially.

* Opportunity to increase hours as we grow.

* Salary negotiable based on experience and skill level.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume.

2. Links to your best editing work (especially short-form content).

3. Your preferred hourly rate in USD.

4. The software you use for editing.

5. The word **"IGNITE"** at the start of your application so we know you read the entire job description.

6. A short 1-2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a good fit for the role.



We are looking for someone long-term who wants to grow with our business and become an important part of our team.

title: AI Powered Video Ad Editor
description:
AI-Powered Video Ad Editor

Full-Time | Remote | $2,000–$3,000 USD per Month



ABOUT THE ROLE



eCare Behavioral Health Institute is looking for a skilled AI-Powered Video Ad Editor to produce high-quality, realistic video advertisements for paid social media.



This is not an entry-level AI video role. We need an experienced editor who already works confidently with AI video-generation tools and can produce videos that do not immediately look AI-generated.



Our team produces a high volume of paid social ads. We need someone who can create genuinely different-looking videos across multiple formats—not repeat the same template, avatar style, or visual treatment in every ad.



You will work from scripts, creative briefs, source footage, voiceovers, and AI-generated assets to create polished, publish-ready advertisements. Formats may include:



* Talking-head and avatar videos

* UGC and creator-style ads

* B-roll-driven videos

* Motion-graphics ads

* Hybrid live-action and AI-generated videos

* Voiceover and caption-led ads



This is a full-time, long-term position for someone who wants to specialize deeply in AI video production and contribute new creative ideas.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Produce a high volume of polished video ads each week

* Generate realistic AI video using Higgsfield or comparable platforms

* Edit source footage, AI-generated clips, voiceovers, music, graphics, and captions

* Create ads across several visibly different formats and visual styles

* Regularly introduce new formats to prevent creative fatigue

* Make AI-generated people, movements, environments, and transitions look as realistic as possible

* Apply hook-first editing, strong pacing, and clear captions for paid social

* Maintain a personal library of creative formats, styles, and techniques

* Proactively recommend new concepts and visual approaches

* Revise videos efficiently based on feedback from the creative and media-buying teams

* Meet weekly production goals without sacrificing quality

* Stay current with emerging AI video tools, features, and production techniques



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



* At least 2 years of professional video-ad editing experience

* At least 1 year of hands-on experience with AI video-generation tools

* A portfolio showing at least 3–5 clearly different video formats or styles

* Demonstrated ability to create realistic AI video that does not appear obviously synthetic

* Experience producing advertisements for Meta, Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms

* Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, visual retention, and direct-response editing

* Ability to work quickly while maintaining attention to detail

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and editing setup capable of fast rendering

* Ability to work full-time and begin within approximately two weeks

* Availability for at least four working hours between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. US Eastern Time



TOOLS AND TECHNICAL SKILLS



You should have professional experience with several of the following:



* Higgsfield or equivalent AI video-generation platforms

* CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or After Effects

* ElevenLabs or other AI voice platforms

* Midjourney or other AI image-generation tools

* AI avatar, lip-sync, motion, or image-to-video tools



Experience with multiple AI video platforms is strongly preferred. We are not looking for someone who only knows how to use one platform’s default templates.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Direct-response or performance-ad experience

* Experience editing UGC or creator-style advertisements

* Experience working with performance data such as CTR, hook rate, watch time, or ad spend

* Healthcare, education, e-learning, or professional-audience experience

* Experience working in a fast-paced creative production environment



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within 30 days:



* You are fully onboarded and consistently meeting the agreed production volume

* You have introduced at least two new video formats beyond our current approach



Within 60 days:



* You are regularly producing ads across at least four distinct formats

* You have helped establish a working library of formats and creative styles



Within 90 days:



* Format variety has become part of our standard production process

* You proactively bring new format ideas to the team instead of waiting for detailed instructions



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



* $2,000–$3,000 USD per month, based on experience, production speed, portfolio quality, and range

* Full-time: 40 hours per week

* Fully remote

* Long-term, in-house position

* Minimum four hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US Eastern Time



WHY JOIN ECARE?



* Stable, ongoing full-time work rather than isolated freelance projects

* High production volume that provides consistent practice and skill development

* Direct feedback from the creative and media-buying teams

* The opportunity to test and develop a wide range of AI video formats

* A team that values experimentation and does not want every video to look the same

* The opportunity to specialize further in the rapidly growing AI video field



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. Links to three video ads you created that look visibly different from one another.

3. For each example, list the AI and editing tools you used and explain which parts were AI-generated.

4. A short explanation of your process for making AI-generated video look realistic.

5. A list of the AI video tools you have used professionally.

6. Any available performance results, such as CTR, hook rate, watch time, conversions, or advertising spend supported.

7. Your desired monthly salary in USD.

8. Your earliest available starting date.

9. Your typical working hours in US Eastern Time.



Please begin your application subject line with the words “AI Video Range” so we know you read the complete posting.



Applications without a relevant portfolio or examples demonstrating multiple video formats will not be considered. A short paid editing assessment may be included in the interview process.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---

title: Senior Video Editor — Long-Form + Short-Form | High Output & Fast Turnaround
description:
Senior Video Editor — Long-Form + Short-Form | High Output & Fast Turnaround



We are looking for an experienced, highly creative, FAST video editor to join our team for ongoing video production.



This is not an entry-level editing position.



We produce a high volume of video content and need an editor who can take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging content quickly — without needing to be micromanaged on every cut, transition, sound effect, hook or creative decision.



You must be comfortable working with both:

* Long-form YouTube and podcast-style content

* Short-form Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head videos

* Educational and marketing content

* Interviews and podcasts

* Promotional/social media content



What We Care About Most:



1. SPEED

We operate at a high production cadence.

You must be able to edit quickly while maintaining quality.

We do not want an editor who needs three days to produce something that a great editor can complete in several hours.



Turnaround time matters.

2. CREATIVE JUDGMENT

We don't want to tell you where to make every cut.



You should understand:

* Hooks

* Pacing

* Pattern interrupts

* B-roll

* Punch-ins

* Text and captions

* Music

* Sound effects

* Storytelling

* Retention editing

* Humor when appropriate

* When NOT to over-edit



You should be able to watch raw footage and immediately begin seeing opportunities to make the finished video better.

3. SHORT-FORM CONTENT



You must understand modern short-form editing.

We want someone who can take a longer piece of content and identify the moments that can become compelling standalone short-form videos.



That means understanding the idea and hook, not simply cutting a 60-second section from a long video.



4. RELIABILITY



We cannot have production stop because:



"My internet went down."

"The electricity went out."

"My computer crashed."



You must have reliable equipment and contingency plans.



Computer Requirements



We strongly prefer editors working on a MacBook Pro with Apple Silicon, although high-performance Windows editing workstations will also be considered.

Preferred specifications:

Mac

* MacBook Pro

* Apple Silicon M1 Pro or newer

* 316 GB RAM Min or more preferred

* SSD storage



Windows

* Modern Intel i7/i9 or AMD Ryzen 7/9

* 16 GB RAM min or more

* Dedicated GPU suitable for professional video editing

* SSD/NVMe storage



Your computer must comfortably handle professional HD and 4K editing without constantly relying on extremely slow renders.



Internet Requirements



You must have:

Primary high-speed internet

* Minimum target: 100 Mbps download

* Minimum target: 50 Mbps upload

AND

A separate backup internet connection.



Your backup can be:

* Secondary ISP

* 5G/LTE hotspot

* Dedicated mobile internet solution



"I can use my neighbor's Wi-Fi" is not considered backup internet.



Backup Power Is Required

You must have a legitimate backup power solution that allows you to continue working during a power outage.



Examples include:

* UPS

* Portable power station

* Generator

* Laptop + high-capacity power solution



Your backup should also keep your modem/router or backup internet system operating.



Software



You should be highly proficient with professional editing software such as:

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut 



Experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Audition and other creative tools is a major advantage.

AI-assisted editing tools and workflows are also a plus.



How To Apply: 



Do NOT send us a generic application.



Start your application with:



FAST EDITOR

Then provide the following:

1. Your best work



Send links to:

* 3 long-form videos you personally edited

* 5 short-form videos you personally edited

Tell us exactly what you were responsible for on each project.



2. Computer Screenshot

Send a screenshot showing your:

* Computer model

* Processor/CPU

* Operating system

* Installed RAM

* GPU, if applicable

* Available storage



Mac users can send a screenshot of About This Mac / System Information.



Windows users should send screenshots showing System Information and Task Manager → Performance.



3. Computer Photo

Send an actual photo of the computer/workstation you currently use.



4. Internet Speed

Send a CURRENT Speedtest screenshot showing:

* Ping

* Download speed

* Upload speed

5. Backup Internet



Send a photo of your backup internet equipment or hotspot and explain what you use.

If possible, also provide a Speedtest screenshot using your backup connection.



6. Backup Power

Send a photo of your UPS, power station, generator or other backup power system.

Tell us approximately how many hours you can continue working during a power outage.



7. Editing Software

Tell us which programs you use and rate your proficiency from 1–10 for each.



8. Editing Speed

Tell us approximately how long it would take you to edit:

* One 10-minute talking-head YouTube video

* One 60-minute podcast/interview

* Five 30–60 second short-form videos



Be realistic. You may be tested on this.



Finalists



Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid editing test using the same raw footage.



We will evaluate:

Quality + Creativity + Speed + Ability to Follow Instructions

A beautiful edit delivered too slowly will not beat an excellent edit delivered quickly.

We're looking for someone who wants consistent work, can handle a serious production schedule, communicates well, takes ownership of their work and wants to become an important part of our content team.

title: USRN (New York License).  Patient Scheduling, Chart Review & RPM/CCM Support
description:
Type of work: Full Time



Salary: $950/month ($5.50/hour)



Hours per week: 40



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern (9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Manila)



Job Description:



We are a US telehealth practice providing primary care and psychiatry to patients in New York. Most of our patients are seniors on Medicare. We are looking for a USRN with an active New York State RN license to join our clinical support team.



This role blends patient-facing phone work with behind-the-scenes clinical quality work. You need to be comfortable doing both.



What you'll do:



Patient communication



Call patients to schedule telehealth visits with our providers

Check patients in before their appointment and help them join the video call

Speak with elderly patients patiently and clearly — many are 70+ and need to be walked through things slowly



Chart & documentation review



Review provider notes in Athenahealth for completeness and quality

Flag missing elements, unsigned notes, incomplete assessments, and documentation that doesn't support the visit level

Report gaps back to the provider for correction — you flag, the provider corrects and signs



RPM / CCM support



Support our Remote Patient Monitoring and Chronic Care Management programs

Review incoming patient vitals and device readings, escalate out-of-range results to the provider

Conduct monthly care management check-in calls with enrolled patients

Log clinical staff time accurately for each patient, every month

Help keep care plans current



Requirements:



Active, unrestricted New York State RN license (we will verify it directly with NYSED — please provide your license number)

Bachelor of Science in Nursing

Clinical nursing experience

Excellent spoken English — an 80-year-old American patient must understand you without asking you to repeat

Strong clinical documentation knowledge

Comfortable on the phone for several hours a day

Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement and complete HIPAA training

Reliable internet (25 Mbps minimum), backup internet, backup power, noise-cancelling headset, quiet private workspace

Committed to US Eastern night shift long-term



Preferred:



Athenahealth experience

Prior RPM, CCM, or care management experience with US patients

Medicare experience

Prior US telehealth or remote clinical role



What we offer:



Long-term, stable role with a growing US practice

Training on our systems and workflows

Pay review at 90 days based on performance

Real clinical work, not pure data entry



To apply:



Start your reply with the word CARDINAL so I know you read this.



Then send:



Your New York RN license number and full name as licensed

A short paragraph on your clinical background and any RPM/CCM or US telehealth experience

A 3-minute video recording (unedited, single take) covering:

A 60-second introduction of yourself and your nursing background

A roleplay: call an 82-year-old patient named Mrs. Rivera to do her monthly chronic care check-in. Ask about her blood pressure readings, her medications, and how she's been feeling.

Tell us the three things you look for first when reviewing a provider's note for completeness

A screenshot of your internet speed test



Applications without the video and license number will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Service Officer/ VA
description:

title: Digital Campaign Marketing & Sales Specialist — Home Services
description:

We are a U.S.-based marketing and business-development partner looking for an experienced Digital Campaign Marketing & Sales Specialist to support a client in the cleaning and home-services industry.



Our client operates an on-demand marketplace where customers can book cleaning and other household services. The business is now expanding into new service categories, including pest control and moving services.



Your primary responsibility will be to create and manage digital campaigns that generate new customers and completed, paid bookings.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant or traditional Social Media Manager position. We need someone who understands how different marketing channels work together to attract customers, generate leads, and increase bookings.



WHAT YOU WILL DO
