* Develop complete customer-acquisition campaigns for new and existing services.

* Create campaign plans covering the audience, offer, messaging, channels, timeline, budget, and KPIs.

* Plan and manage campaigns through
, social media, Meta Ads, Google Ads, landing pages, retargeting, and local marketing.

* Help organize and segment customer data in Mailchimp or other CRM platforms.

* Create or review conversion-focused copy for advertisements,
s, social media, and landing pages.

* Develop promotional, referral, and customer-reactivation campaigns when approved.

* Prepare clear instructions and creative briefs for designers, video editors,
 specialists, and website support.

* Coordinate campaign production, approvals, deadlines, and launches.

* Test campaign links, forms, promotional codes, landing pages, and booking processes.

* Follow up with qualified leads when needed and help convert them into customers.

* Track leads, new customers, completed bookings, revenue, cancellations, and refunds.

* Identify weak points in the customer journey and improve campaign performance.

* Prepare clear weekly and monthly reports with results and recommendations.



COMPENSATION AND COMMISSION



The selected candidate will receive:



* $700 USD monthly base salary

* Additional performance-based commission

* Long-term growth opportunities based on performance



Commission will be available for eligible new customers generated through the specialist’s assigned campaigns.



A customer must complete and fully pay for an eligible service before commission is earned. Canceled, refunded, fraudulent, or test bookings will not qualify.



The commission rate, eligible services, customer-attribution rules, performance targets, and payment schedule will be discussed during the interview and documented in the final compensation agreement.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* At least three years of digital marketing, campaign marketing, growth marketing, or digital sales experience.

* Proven experience creating and managing customer-acquisition campaigns.

* Experience with cleaning, home services, local services, marketplaces, booking platforms, or a related industry.

* Good understanding of lead generation, sales funnels, customer conversion, and service bookings.

* Experience with
 marketing, CRM segmentation, and automation.

* Mailchimp experience is strongly preferred.

* Working knowledge of Meta Ads and/or Google Ads.

* Experience with landing pages, retargeting, promotions, and lead follow-up.

* Understanding of UTMs, conversion tracking, and campaign attribution.

* Ability to write or review conversion-focused marketing copy.

* Ability to connect marketing results to leads, customers, bookings, and revenue.

* Strong organization, communication, analytical, and project-management skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple team members.



STRONG ADVANTAGES



Experience with any of the following is an advantage:



* Cleaning, pest control, moving, or storage services

* Home-service or app-based marketplaces

* U.S. or New York markets

* Local SEO and Google Business Profile

* Customer-reactivation or referral campaigns

* Agency or outsourced client management



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



* Campaigns launch on time with clear goals and accurate tracking.

* Marketing channels work together as one coordinated campaign.

* Campaigns generate qualified leads and verified new customers.

* New services receive completed, paid bookings.

* Campaign results are measured and improved based on data.

* The team receives clear instructions, deadlines, and reports.

Mailchimp

Meta Ads

Google Ads

description:

Qualifications

• Experience with QuickBooks required.

• Ability to work independently while also contributing as a team member.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage time effectively.





Work Environment

This position requires a proactive, organized professional who thrives in a dynamic office environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable managing routine accounting responsibilities while responding to time-sensitive requests and supporting a variety of business operations.

title: Power BI Developer / Analytics Engineer
description:
We build automated data pipelines and Power BI reporting for companies in the pest control and home services industry. Data is pulled nightly from field service platforms, CRMs, and ad platforms into a central data lake, then modeled and surfaced in Power BI for owners and operators.

We are looking for a Power BI developer who can own the reporting layer: taking structured data and turning it into dashboards that are fast, well designed, and genuinely useful to management. This is a long-term role with steady work, not a one-off project.



What you'll actually be doing

The bulk of your time will be building and refining Power BI reports and semantic models. You'll work from staged datasets we produce for you and be responsible for the model, the DAX, the visuals, and the performance of the finished report.



Specifically:

- Design and build Power BI semantic models — relationships, star schemas, calculated tables, and measures

- Write and optimize DAX, including time intelligence, rate and ratio measures, ranking, and correct total-row behavior

- Translate business questions into well-defined KPIs and metric definitions, and push back when a request is ambiguous

- Build dashboards that are lightweight and load quickly; we care about report performance as much as appearance

- Design report layouts that a business owner can read in ten seconds — clear hierarchy, restrained visuals, no clutter

- Implement drill-through, bookmarks, slicer logic, and role-level security where needed

- Combine and reconcile data across multiple unrelated source systems

- Clean, transform, structure, and validate data prior to modeling

- Reconcile report output against source data and investigate discrepancies

- Identify data-quality problems, flag them clearly, and propose fixes rather than working around them silently

- Handle messy source data defensively (malformed dates, inconsistent categories, missing keys)

- Automate recurring reporting wherever practical instead of repeating manual work

- Build forecasts, projections, and scenario models where the business needs forward-looking numbers

- Support ad hoc analysis and one-off requests from management

- Document measures, assumptions, data sources, and reporting logic so the model is maintainable by someone other than you

- Publish and manage reports in Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, app distribution)



Required

- Advanced Power BI — this is the core of the role. Data modeling, DAX, Power Query, relationships, calculated tables and columns, KPI development, drill-through, and dashboard design. You should be able to explain why a measure returns the wrong total and fix it.

- Demonstrated eye for report design. We will ask to see examples of your work.

- Comfort working with large datasets across multiple unrelated source systems

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability — able to take a vague business question and turn it into a defensible number

- Excellent attention to detail and a low tolerance for numbers that don't tie out

- Ability to work independently with limited supervision and asynchronous communication

- Strong written English — clear enough to document your own work and explain a discrepancy in writing

- Reliable availability with meaningful overlap with US Pacific business hours



Strongly preferred

- Working knowledge of the broader Microsoft ecosystem — SharePoint and SharePoint document libraries, OneDrive, Microsoft 365, Power BI Service administration, and Microsoft Fabric / OneLake concepts

- Python — enough to read, modify, and debug data extraction and aggregation scripts (pandas, requests). You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should not be blocked by a script.

- Git and GitHub basics — clone, branch, commit, push, pull requests

- SQL

- Advanced Excel where it supports analysis and reconciliation — Power Query, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, dynamic arrays, and operational or financial modeling



Nice to have

- Snowflake, or experience with any cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse)

- Power Automate, Power Apps, or Dataverse

- Google Looker Studio or other BI platforms (Tableau, Qlik)

- Experience with APIs and automated data extraction

- ETL/ELT experience

- Comfort using AI tools such as Claude for coding, troubleshooting, and analysis — we use them daily and expect you to as well



Working with us

You will be handling confidential client business data. Signing an NDA is a condition of the role, and client data stays within the systems we provide — nothing gets copied to personal machines or accounts. We take this seriously and expect you to as well.

We are a small team, so you will have direct access to the technical lead, clear priorities, and no bureaucracy. In exchange we expect ownership: if a report is slow or a number looks wrong, we want you to raise it rather than ship it.



How to apply

Include links or screenshots of Power BI reports you have personally built, and briefly describe one reporting problem you solved that required non-obvious DAX or model design. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed.

If you thrive with autonomy, know how to read data and make calls, and have a track record of turning ad spend into actual revenue — keep reading.



The difference between a campaign manager and what we're after: one reports the numbers, the other moves them.

description:
Hiring Two (2) Business Development & Housing Operations Specialists

 

Referral Partnerships | Property & Resident Coordination

·      Remote Independent Contractor 

·      $4–$6 USD per hour + $100+ USD Performance Incentives Bonuses Securing Partners & Properties | 25–40 hours per week  

·      Reliable availability during U.S. Central Time business hours required

 

Base Compensation + Performance Incentives Bonuses and Schedule

Final work schedule, payment method, contractor terms, and system access will be documented before production work begins

·      Schedule: 25–40 hours per week with reliable availability during agreed U.S. Central Time hours, ideally 9am-5pm. Front-office calling will take place during referral partners’ normal business hours.

·      Base pay: $4–$6 USD per hour, depending on experience, demonstrated skills, and assigned responsibilities.

·      Performance Incentives: In addition to hourly compensation, eligible contractors earn:

·      A $100 USD Placement Conversion Bonus for each qualified referral relationships they originate that results in a completed and verified resident placement.

·      A $100 USD Property Conversion Bonus for each qualified property leads that results in a fully executed, owner-approved Incentive Bonuses are paid only after the placement or lease has been verified.

 

How to Apply

Please provide all of the following: Please note that applications that do not address the requested information may not be considered.

·      Your resume (CV), detailing summary of your relevant work experience.

·      A video introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Please provide a Loom or Google Drive link rather than attaching a large video file, be sure to include the following: 

1.        A brief example of the work you have completed and any performance goals you were responsible for, such as call volume, appointment setting, conversion rates, follow-up completion, or data-quality standards.

2.        Your requested hourly rate within the advertised $4–$6 USD range.

3.        Your weekly availability and the exact hours you can consistently work in U.S. Central Time.

4.        Confirmation that you have a reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, and quiet workspace.

 

About Company

Growing Shared Housing Company is expanding its housing and community referral network throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth area. We are building a professional, paperless operating system for referral-partner development, property outreach, resident onboarding, and shared-housing administration.

 

About the Role

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented professionals who can help develop referral relationships while keeping our housing operations organized and execution-ready. Depending on your experience and strengths, you may be assigned primarily a combination of referral outreach, relationship development, appointment setting, property outreach, resident data administration, and limited marketing support. 



Key Responsibilities

 

Referral Partnerships and Business Development

·      Make high-volume (
) outbound calls to hospitals, case managers, veteran organizations, senior-service providers, behavioral-health organizations, reentry programs, housing agencies, nonprofits, and other community referral sources.

·      Verify primary contacts, public
 addresses, phone numbers, and organizational information using reliable public sources.

·      Introduce the Company professionally using approved phone, voi
, and
 scripts.

·      Send timely follow-up
s and approved informational materials after meaningful conversations.

·      Schedule referral-partner introductions, resident-assessment meetings, lunch-and-learns, open-house tours, and follow-up calls.

·      Build and nurture relationships that can develop into consistent housing-placement referrals.

·      Record every outreach attempt, conversation, outcome, contact update, and next action in 
.

·      Escalate active referrals, pricing questions, accommodation requests, complaints, legal concerns, and other sensitive matters to the owner.

 

Property Outreach

·      Make outbound calls to determine property availability, pricing, lease terms, location, and suitability.

·      Communicate the Company's intended housing use accurately and only through approved messaging.

·      Maintain professional and consistent follow-up with property contacts.

·      Organize property information, communication histories, and due-diligence materials for leadership review.

·      Escalate promising property opportunities before making commitments or discussing non-approved terms.

 

Housing and Resident Operations

·      Monitor referral and intake submissions and route them into the appropriate 
 workflow.

·      Help coordinate paperless resident intake and onboarding.

·      Manage approved onboarding documents, checklists, signature tracking, and file-completion follow-up.

·      Schedule resident assessments and informational meetings.

·      Maintain accurate records of available housing units, incoming referrals, placement status, and next steps.

·      Support ongoing resident communications, including approved maintenance, extension, relocation, and move-out coordination.

·      Provide limited RentRedi support for resident records, agreements, payment status, and maintenance administration after access is approved.



 

Marketing and Administrative Support

Depending on the assigned workstream, responsibilities may also include:

·      Manage the Company’s Instagram presence and maintain a consistent, professional brand voice.

·      Draft, design, and schedule weekly branded social media content using Canva to create clean graphics, informational materials, and simple marketing layouts.

·      Send and respond to approved referral-partner
s.

·      Coordinate calendars, meetings, reminders, and event logistics.

·      Assist with preparation for lunch-and-learns, open houses, and referral-partner presentations.

·      Support controlled document organization and general administrative tasks.

 

Work Performance Expectations

·      Maintain 100% same-day CRM documentation for assigned outreach and follow-up activities.

·      Follow approved scripts while sounding natural, warm, and professional.

·      Complete follow-up tasks on time and maintain accurate next-action dates.

·      Meet assigned outreach, data-quality, and workflow-completion goals.

·      Front-office team members will gradually ramp toward approximately 150–200 outbound attempts during a full calling day after training.

·      Activity expectations will be adjusted according to scheduled hours and assigned responsibilities.

·      Higher calling volumes will be introduced only when communication quality, follow-up, and documentation remain at standard.

·      Accept coaching professionally and correct errors promptly.

·      Communicate early when a deadline, system issue, or unresolved question may affect completion.

 

Required Qualifications

·      Strong spoken and written English.

·      A professional, warm, and confident phone presence.

·      Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, business development, lead generation, customer service, housing, healthcare outreach, social services, or property administration.

·      Comfort spending a significant portion of the workday making outbound calls.

·      Accurate online research, data-entry, and record-management skills.

·      Experience maintaining CRM notes, contact records, pipeline stages, tags, and follow-up tasks.

·      Ability to distinguish verified facts from assumptions and label unverified information appropriately.

·      Strong organization, attention to detail, judgment, and follow-through.

·      Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring responsibilities independently.

·      Ability to follow scripts, SOPs, checklists, approval processes, and confidentiality requirements.

·      Reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, and quiet workspace.

·      Consistent availability during agreed U.S. Central Time working hours, 9am-5pm ideally.

 

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is helpful BUT is NOT required since training will be provided:

·      
, Jotform, RentRedi, or comparable CRM, form, and property-management platforms

·      Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, and Calendar

·      Canva and business social media management

·      Hospital, case-management, senior-service, veteran-service, behavioral-health, reentry, or community-resource outreach

·      Shared housing, resident intake, leasing, document collection, maintenance coordination, or file auditing

·      Property sourcing or landlord/property-manager outreach

·      High-volume business-to-business calling with detailed same-day CRM notes

·      Customer success, community management, operations, or executive-assistant support



Systems We Use: Experience with every platform is not required. We are more interested in your ability to learn new systems quickly, follow established processes, and maintain accurate records.

·      
 for CRM records, pipelines, work queues, approvals, and follow-up tasks

·      Jotform for referral, intake, document-upload, and resident-support forms

·      RentRedi for approved property, resident, agreement, payment-status, and maintenance administration

·      Google Workspace for business
, calendars, spreadsheets, documents, and archived files

·      Canva for basic graphics and branded marketing materials

·      Company-approved business calling and communication tools

title: Presentation Designer (Advanced PowerPoint and Animated Slide Decks)

- Experience designing for B2B or technology companies

Send a short note about your experience plus links to two or three decks you're proud of. Tell us which deck you'd rebuild first if you joined us, and why. We read every application that follows the instructions in this post.

ABOUT VERITAS

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets.



We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role.



THE DETAILS

• Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position

• Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time

• Fully remote and long-term

• This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage

• Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS

Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



HOW THE ROLE FITS

You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you.



You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership.



HOW WE USE AI

Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory.



We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

• Have at least eight years of professional work experience.

• Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports.

• Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story.

• Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why.

• Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck.

• Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers.

• Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings.

• Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting.

• Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients.

• A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable.

• Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal.

• Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results.

• Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work.

• Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it.



HOW WE WORK

Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves.



Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: Experienced Airbnb  & Booking.com Pricing & Listing Optimisation Specialist – Experience Required

We currently manage approximately 70 short-stay properties and are looking for someone with extensive, demonstrated experience in short-term rental pricing, revenue management and listing optimisation.



Experience is a must.



This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone looking to learn short-stay pricing or listing optimisation from scratch. We are looking for someone who can come into the role with strong existing knowledge, review our portfolio, identify opportunities and make meaningful improvements to occupancy, nightly rates, listing visibility, conversion and overall revenue.



The role will initially be approximately one day per week, with the possibility of additional hours and shifts for the right person.



Key Responsibilities

* Reviewing property performance across Airbnb, 
 and other booking channels.

* Reviewing and improving listing titles, descriptions, amenities, photographs and overall presentation.

* Conducting competitor and market analysis.

* Has strong knowledge of Airbnb ranking, SEO and conversion optimisation.

title: Construction Project Coordinator & Scheduler VA
description:
Type of Work: Full-time

Salary: $10 AUD/hr 

 

About Us

Elite Makeovers is a leading renovation company based in Perth, Western Australia, specialising in stunning transformations of bathrooms, kitchens, and laundries. With over 14 years of experience, we are known for our high-quality craftsmanship, innovative designs, and exceptional customer service.



We are looking for an exceptionally capable Construction Project Coordinator & Scheduler to work closely with our Operations Manager and assist with the day-to-day coordination, scheduling and quoting of our renovation projects.



This is not a basic administrative VA role.



We are looking for someone intelligent, proactive and highly reliable who understands construction, communicates confidently and can think ahead to identify potential problems before they affect a project.



The right person will become an integral part of our operations team and develop a strong understanding of how our business and renovation projects operate.

 

Key Responsibilities



Project Scheduling & Coordination

• Assist the Operations Manager with scheduling multiple renovation projects.

• Coordinate and book trades, subcontractors and suppliers for upcoming works.

• Maintain and update project schedules using 
 and Excel.

• Ensure trades are booked in the correct sequence and at the appropriate stage of each project.

• Confirm upcoming works with trades and follow up where required.

• Reschedule and reorganise jobs when delays, trade availability, variations, site issues or other complications affect the original construction schedule.

• Understand how changes to one part of a project can affect subsequent trades, deliveries and completion dates.

• Work with the Operations Manager to find practical solutions when scheduling complications arise.

• Keep project information, dates and job statuses accurate and up to date.

• Assist with coordinating materials, deliveries and other project requirements.

• Monitor upcoming works and proactively identify potential delays, clashes or missing requirements before they become problems on site.



Quoting & Learning the Business

Quoting will be an important part of the role, particularly during the initial training period.

You will learn how Elite Makeovers prices and delivers renovation projects so that you develop a detailed understanding of our complete business and construction process.



Your responsibilities will include:

• Prepare and assist with detailed renovation project quotes.

• Learn our quoting structure, pricing systems and standard project allowances.

• Review plans, scopes, selections and project information to determine what needs to be included in a quote.

• Obtain and follow up pricing from subcontractors and suppliers.

• Understand the different trades, materials and stages required to complete a renovation.

• Compare subcontractor and supplier quotes and identify missing items or inconsistencies.

• Enter and maintain accurate project pricing and costing information.

• Develop an understanding of our suppliers, subcontractors, construction methods and typical project costs.

• Use the knowledge gained through quoting to better understand project sequencing, scheduling requirements and potential construction issues.



While quoting will not be the primary long-term focus of this position, you must be willing and able to quote projects. We see this as an essential part of learning how our business operates and developing the construction knowledge required to effectively coordinate our projects.



Trade & Supplier Communication

• Communicate confidently with Australian tradespeople, subcontractors and suppliers.

• Book trades and confirm availability, dates and project requirements.

• Follow up outstanding quotes, information, materials and bookings.

• Clearly communicate job requirements and changes.

• Build professional working relationships with our regular trades and suppliers.

• Escalate issues to the Operations Manager when required.

 

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a high-calibre candidate who can eventually operate with significant independence rather than someone who needs every task explained step-by-step.



You should have:

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong verbal communication skills and the confidence to speak with Australian tradespeople and suppliers.

• Previous experience in the construction, renovation, engineering, architecture or related industry.

• A strong understanding of how construction projects are coordinated.

• Excellent organisational and scheduling skills.

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking ability.

• The ability to look ahead and spot potential problems before they happen.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• The ability to prioritise multiple projects and competing deadlines.

• Confidence working with spreadsheets and project management systems.

• A high level of reliability and personal accountability.

• The ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

• A proactive attitude — if you notice something is missing or doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate rather than simply ignore it.



Highly Regarded Experience

Candidates with any of the following backgrounds will be particularly well suited:

• Construction Project Coordinator

title: Media Buyer & Conversion Specialist (Google Ads + Meta) | NZ Agency
description:
We're a small marketing agency in New Zealand. We do marketing for financial advisers, mostly mortgage and insurance advisers and KiwiSaver specialists. We're looking for someone to help run the ad accounts (with our overseeing) so we can focus on growing the business).



*What you'd actually be doing*



Taking over the day to day of our client accounts across Meta, Google and Bing.



We set the strategy and the budgets, and we sign off anything significant. Past that, the accounts are yours. You decide what runs, what gets paused, where the money moves, and which keywords are wasting it.



The other half of the job is what happens after the click. Our funnels and landing pages are built in GoHighLevel, and you'd be reviewing and improving them. Form flow, drop-off, question order, layout, load speed. There's not much point winning the auction if the page loses the lead.



Please read this bit before applying:

Nearly half of what we manage is search rather than social, and search is where we need you strongest.



We see a lot of applications from Meta specialists who have picked up a bit of Google along the way. There's nothing wrong with that, but it isn't this job. If your search experience is "I've run some campaigns", please save us both the time. We do test this properly, and there's no clever way to talk your way around a search terms report.



*What we need*

- 3+ years running paid campaigns with real budgets. Agency-side ideally, since you'd be moving between clients here

- Real Meta Ads Manager experience and real Google Ads search experience. Both of them, not one and a bit of the other

Lead generation rather than ecommerce. We're not selling products, we're getting people to pick up the phone, and the levers are different

- GoHighLevel, or another CRM and funnel builder you picked up quickly

- Good written English. You'll be documenting every change you make and you'll be in our Slack every day

- Online 7am to 11am Manila time. We're based in New Zealand and need to be able to communicate during business hours.

Nice to have but not required: financial services, mortgage or insurance advertising. GA4 and Tag Manager. Any landing page testing background. Meta or Google certifications.



*What we're like to work for*

Our clients are licensed financial advisers, which means there are real legal rules about what their ads can say. So anything a consumer will read, ad copy, headlines, anything mentioning rates, comes to us first. Everything else you just get on with.



Every change gets logged with the date and the reason you made it. That's the one thing we're strict about. It's how we stay out of your way without losing track of what's happening.



If something breaks or a cost per lead jumps, tell us the same day. Nobody here gets in trouble for bad news arriving early.



You'll always know what you're aiming for, because every client has a target cost per lead written down.



This is part-time and long-term, a direct contract with us. No agency in the middle taking a cut. Paid every fortnight through Wise on the 15th and the 30th. We've never paid anyone late and we don't intend to start with you.



*How to apply*

Please don't send a template. We read every application and we can spot one from the first line.

Tell us about an account you took over that wasn't working. What was wrong with it, what you did, what happened to the numbers afterwards. Under 250 words, and use real numbers rather than "improved significantly"

Tell us honestly whether you're stronger on Meta or on Google search, and why.

Your CV or profile, any certifications, and the hourly rate you're looking for in USD

Start your message with the word ORCHARD so we know you got this far



If you're shortlisted we'll send you a real account to look at. It takes about 90 minutes and we pay you your rate for it, because your time is worth something before you work here as well as after.



Then a video call. We're hoping to have someone chosen by mid September.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Founding Operations Associate — Short-Term Rental (Growth path to managerial/leadership role)
description:
Founding Operations Associate — Short-Term Rental (Growth path to managerial/leadership role)



Location: Remote 

Type: Full-time 

Compensation: $1000 to $1200 per Month / 40 hours per week — starting out at $1000 per month, increasing to $1200 per month at the end of your 90-day probation period, subject to meeting KPIs and additional work scope.

Employment: The initial employment term will be temporary for the first 90 days*. 



Our Listings:




/h/lazyrealm


/h/lazytiny


/h/mountainsandmoon



About Us



Hi there, future colleague! My name is Daniel, I’m a design enthusiast and the founder of Wildara Vacation Rentals. We were founded in 2024 and currently own and manage a small portfolio of premium short-term rental properties in California, with an active pipeline (mid to late 2027) to launch a boutique glamping resort development in Texas — 10 to 14 design-forward tiny home cabins with private wellness amenities and an event venue component. Our mission is to create beautifully designed, one-of-a-kind experiences that guests will remember and cherish. 



We're hiring a Founding Operations Associate who shares our same passion for hospitality — someone who takes ownership and catches the small things before they become guest issues, is comfortable building process out of ambiguity rather than waiting for a script, genuinely appreciates the design and experience details that set us apart, and has the patience to grow with us for the long haul rather than chase a quick win. Above all, you care as much as we do about giving every guest an experience worth remembering.



You will own day-to-day guest communications, vendor coordination, and property operations across our current portfolio. This is not a static task-execution role — it's the ground floor of a long-term career and a rare opportunity to become a key member of a successful organization. You will be building out SOPs and laying the foundation for our future team expansion. As the Texas glamping properties come online, this position is designed to grow into a managerial/leadership role as our business scales.



What We Use



We value your time, that’s why we use HostBuddy AI to help automate routine, repeatable guest messaging, so you won't be handling every message manually — your focus will be on coordination, judgment calls, exceptions, and keeping operations running smoothly, not answering the same FAQ fifty times a day.



Some of the software/services we currently use to automate and manage our operations:



HostBuddy AI

Hospitable

Breezeway

Pricelabs

Truvi / Superhog

RankBreeze



What You'll Own (Including but not limited to)



Daily



Review HostBuddy conversation history and resolve any open guest tasks

Assign and follow up on cleaner tasks in Breezeway

Track deliveries and notify service providers as needed

Review cleaning results in Breezeway — check for staging, stains/damages, supply levels, propane levels, trash levels, and deliveries

Build and manage a running to-do list: maintenance items, restocking requests, last-minute or early/late check-in-outs, cleaner follow-ups on linens or lost & found

Confirm all doors are locked, adjust thermostats per seasonal settings, and check that lights/cameras (Wyze) are online, resetting light timers as needed



Weekly



Monitor pricing and occupancy; flag issues or anomalies

Maintain and update listing details as needed



Quarterly



Coordinate routine maintenance inspections

File county TOT (transient occupancy tax) reports



Annual



Run full inventory checks (dishware, linens, towels, etc.)

Schedule deep cleans and monitor results



Ongoing



Document and refine workflows and SOPs as you learn the operation

Help source, screen, and train additional team members as we scale

File damage/insurance claims when needed

Support basic bookkeeping tasks

Upsell early check-in / late check-out and other service packages



What We're Looking For



Prior hands-on experience with Airbnb, Vrbo, 
 and other STR platforms — you understand guest expectations and how a well-run property operates, not just customer service in the abstract

Excellent verbal and written communication as well as a professional demeanor for guest and vendor interactions

Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you'll be tracking multiple properties, vendors, and recurring deadlines at once, and building systems and processes to streamline operations

Self-motivated and comfortable driving initiatives independently — we want someone who builds and improves processes, not just follows a script

Comfortable handling maintenance coordination and knowing when an issue needs escalation vs. a standard fix

Tech-savvy — Has expertise in Google Suite, willing to learn new software and platforms as necessary, and using AI to improve operational efficiency

Growth-minded — genuinely interested in taking on more ownership as the business expands, not just looking for a fixed-scope task role

Access to stable high-speed internet (speedtest link required; https://www.speedtest.net)

Must have your own computer, backup power, and internet connection in case of power interruptions

Flexibility with working hours, including evenings and weekends as needed

Must not have other employment as we require your full dedication. A quiet work environment is necessary



Required Days/Hours:



Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM PST (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)

*Please note that the US observes daylight savings time.



Growth Path



This role is structured to grow in three stages:

Customer Service and Operations Associate: Own day-to-day communications, vendor coordination, and property upkeep across the current portfolio.

Operations Manager (as Texas glamping launches): Take on multi-site coordination, vendor relationships in a new market, and build out our team with additional hires and systems.

Leadership Role (as the business scales): Oversee managers and systems across multiple sites as we grow.



Promotion and compensation increases are tied to demonstrated ownership at each stage, not tenure alone.



How to Apply



If you are interested in this position, please send an application with the EXACT subject line “I’m your next Experienced and Dedicated Founding Operations Associate” and include the following:

-Your resume/CV

-Your speedtest.net link for internet speed verification

-Complete our skill assessment here: 
 

-Showcase your qualifications and enthusiasm by attaching a short video recording (using whichever recorder you prefer - can be a recording from your phone) explaining the following:

1. Brief introduction of yourself and your experience (What STR platforms or property management systems have you used (Airbnb, Vrbo, Hospitable, etc., and what did your day-to-day work look like)?

2. Tell me about a specific time you turned around a guest's bad experience into a great one. What happened, what did you do, and how did it feel afterward? 

3. Tell me about a time you noticed a recurring problem at a job and built a process, checklist, or fix for it without being asked. 

4. This role starts with guest communications and operations but is designed to grow into a leadership role as we scale into Texas. What does a growth path like that mean to you, and how do you think about the timeline for taking on more responsibility?

title: Research and Source Verification Assistant
description:
We are building an online professional exam preparation platform and are looking for a careful, detail oriented research assistant to help verify educational content.



This is primarily a manual research, fact checking, and data verification role. You do not need experience with California real estate, law, or professional licensing. We will provide detailed instructions, the question being reviewed, the proposed answer, and the government sources you should search.



Your job is not to interpret laws or d
 what an answer should be. Your job is to find direct evidence from the assigned official source and accurately document what you find.



A typical assignment will look like this:



1. Read a multiple choice question and its proposed correct answer.

2. Open the official government source provided with the assignment.

3. Use the provided search terms or document section to locate information related to the proposed answer.

4. Determine whether the source directly supports the proposed answer.

5. Record the exact URL and the specific page, section, statute, regulation, or other location where the information appears.

6. Take a screenshot showing the relevant information directly from the source.

7. Mark the question as one of the following:

-Verified

-Could Not Verify

-Conflict Found



8. Enter the requested information accurately into Google Sheets.



If you cannot clearly verify something, you should mark it Could Not Verify rather than guess.





AI RULE

AI tools may not be used to perform the source verification work or the paid screening test.



This includes ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI search summaries, AI browser assistants, or similar tools.



Verification must be performed manually by opening and reading the actual source material provided.



Do not use blogs, Reddit, Quizlet, other exam preparation websites, or unofficial websites as substitutes for the assigned official source.



We are looking for someone who:



1. Has excellent attention to detail.

2. Can follow written instructions very closely.

3. Has strong English reading comprehension.

4. Is comfortable searching long documents and government websites for specific information.

5. Is comfortable working in Google Sheets.

6. Can accurately record URLs, page numbers, sections, and other source references.

7. Can take and organize screenshots.

8. Is comfortable saying Could Not Verify instead of guessing.

9. Is dependable and communicates clearly when there is a problem.



Accuracy is more important than simply completing a large number of items. However, we are also looking for someone who works efficiently and consistently.



The position will begin at approximately 10 hours per week at $5 per hour.



The first two weeks will be a trial period. If your work is accurate, efficient, and reliable, there is potential for additional hours and long term work as the project grows.



Selected applicants will complete a short paid source verification test before being hired.





APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Start your application with the exact words:

MANUAL RESEARCH



Then answer all five questions below:



1. Describe any previous work you have done involving online research, fact checking, data entry, document review, or information verification.

2. How comfortable are you searching long government documents or websites to find one specific fact or rule?

3. What is your normal weekly availability, and during what hours do you usually work?

4. Are you comfortable completing a paid research test before being hired?

5. Confirm that you understand that AI tools cannot be used to complete the source verification work or the paid screening test.



Applications that do not begin with MANUAL RESEARCH or do not answer all five questions will not be considered.

title: Podcast Editor
description:
JOB SCOPE:



The selected Podcast Editor will convert approved audio and video recordings into polished, platform-ready episodes for The PACE Playbook. The role includes production intake, multitrack editing, audio cleanup, quality control, review exports, authorized revisions, final masters and asset organization. The initial cadence is approximately two episodes per month, with an initial planning estimate of approximately 30 authorized hours per month. Program management, client communication, guest coordination, approval management, publishing and release administration remain with the Program Lead. Website development, sponsorship operations, guest sourcing, broader marketing strategy and original music composition are outside this role unless separately authorized by Well Aware.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.  Podcast Production

- Receive source recordings, episode briefs, brand assets and production instructions through the Well Aware Program Lead, then confirm completeness before editing begins

- Synchronize separate audio and video tracks; clean noise, balance levels and correct routine recording issues

- Edit full-length episodes for pacing and clarity, removing approved false starts, interruptions and technical gaps without changing editorial meaning

- Apply approved intro and outro elements, titles, lower thirds, captions and brand treatments

- Export review cuts and final platform-ready audio, video, transcript and caption files to documented specifications

- Complete technical and content-continuity quality checks before each review handoff

- Implement revisions from client feedback consolidated and authorized by the Well Aware Program Lead



2.  File Handoff and Asset Management

- Prepare final approved audio and video masters, captions, transcripts and supporting files for publication by the Program Lead

- Provide any assigned titles, descriptions, show notes, chapters, thumbnails, captions or metadata drafts to the Program Lead for review and publication

- Verify that final masters play correctly and meet the approved technical specifications before handoff

- Maintain organized working, review, approved and final files in the designated Google Drive folders using agreed naming and version standards

- Update production status, document final file locations and report blockers or quality risks early

- Use delegated access only when required to retrieve or deliver production assets, and follow Well Aware credential-handling and access-safety requirements





REQUIREMENTS:



- Demonstrated experience editing professional audio and video podcasts, supported by relevant long-form work samples or satisfactory completion of a practical editing assessment

- Strong multitrack audio cleanup, synchronization, leveling, pacing and long-form video editing skills

- Proficiency with Riverside or a comparable recording platform, Google Drive and professional editing tools suitable for long-form audio and video production

- Ability to produce platform-ready audio, video, transcript and caption files to documented specifications

- Strong quality control, file organization, version control and deadline management

- Ability to work from an episode brief, preserve editorial meaning and flag content concerns without making unauthorized substantive changes

- Secure credential handling, stable internet access and sufficient local or cloud storage for large media files

- Clear written communication and early escalation of missing assets, quality issues or schedule risks



NICE-TO-HAVES:



- Experience drafting or formatting show notes, episode descriptions, chapters and transcripts

- Ability to create short-form clips, audiograms, basic thumbnails or other promotional derivatives when separately assigned

- Familiarity with healthcare, PACE or other regulated professional content

- Experience reviewing native podcast and YouTube analytics

- Ability to source properly licensed music and assemble simple intro and outro packages; original music composition is not part of the core scope



HOURS & SCHEDULE:



- Fractional client assignment through Well Aware, with an initial planning estimate of approximately 30 authorized hours per month and no guaranteed minimum

- Expected workload is approximately two full-length audio and video episodes per month, with launch-period hours varying by episode length and source-file quality

- The selected specialist should be available to begin onboarding promptly and support recordings expected in early September

Experienced Property Management Virtual Assistant – Full Time / Long Term



We are a U.S.-based residential property management and real estate company looking for an experienced, highly organized Property Management Virtual Assistant in the Philippines for a long-term position.



This is NOT a beginner VA or basic data-entry position.



We are specifically looking for someone who has previous experience working with a U.S. property management or real estate company and understands the day-to-day responsibilities involved in managing residential rental properties.



We currently use Rent Manager as our property management software.



Previous Rent Manager experience is a major advantage.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



Your responsibilities will include:



Communicating with tenants by phone, text, and

Receiving and managing maintenance requests

Coordinating repairs with contractors/vendors

Following up with contractors until jobs are completed

Following up with tenants after repairs

Keeping maintenance records updated

Working inside Rent Manager

Updating tenant and property information

Reviewing and organizing rental applications

Communicating with prospective tenants

Scheduling apartment showings

Following up with rental leads

Assisting with tenant screening and verification

Calling previous landlords and employers when needed

Tracking rent payments and tenant balances

Following up on outstanding tenant matters

Preparing letters, notices,
s, and other documents from templates

Scheduling inspections and appointments

Maintaining organized electronic files and records

Using spreadsheets and task lists

Researching information online

Handling general administrative work

Assisting the owner with additional business and administrative tasks as needed

WHAT WE ARE REALLY LOOKING FOR



We don't want someone who only completes a task when specifically reminded.



We need someone who can take ownership of an issue and follow it through until it is completed.



For example:



If a plumber says, “I'll call you tomorrow,” you should follow up tomorrow without waiting for us to remind you.



If a tenant reports a maintenance problem, you should track the issue until the contractor completes the work and the tenant confirms that it has been resolved.



If information is missing from an application, you should notice it and follow up.



If something doesn't make sense, you should ask questions instead of ignoring it.



We are looking for someone who is:



Extremely organized

Dependable

Honest

Detail-oriented

Proactive

Good at solving problems

Comfortable taking responsibility

Excellent at following up

Able to prioritize urgent vs. non-urgent situations

Comfortable dealing professionally with tenants and contractors

Able to work independently after being trained

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Previous experience with U.S. property management or real estate

Excellent spoken English

Excellent written English

Comfortable speaking on the phone with U.S. tenants, applicants, contractors, landlords, and other parties

Strong computer skills

Good knowledge of Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office

Experience using spreadsheets

Reliable computer

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet environment for making professional phone calls

Ability to work during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time business hours

PROPERTY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE



We currently use Rent Manager.



If you already have Rent Manager experience, please explain exactly what you have done inside the software.



Experience with other U.S. property-management software is also valuable.



COMPENSATION



This is intended to be a full-time, long-term position.



Compensation will depend on your experience, English communication skills, property-management knowledge, Rent Manager experience, and overall qualifications.



Please include your requested monthly salary in USD when applying.



There will be an initial paid trial/probationary period.



We are looking for someone who can grow with our company and take on additional responsibility over time.



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY.



Generic applications will not be considered.



Start your application with the words:



GREEN KEY



Then answer ALL of the following questions and number your answers 1–12.



1. How many years of experience do you have working for a U.S. property management or real estate company?



2. Tell us about the company or companies you worked for and describe your actual day-to-day responsibilities.



3. Approximately how many rental units/properties were you helping manage?



4. Have you used Rent Manager?



If YES:



How long did you use it?

What did you personally do inside Rent Manager?

Which areas/features did you use regularly?



If NO:



Which property-management software have you used?



5. Describe your experience communicating directly with tenants. Did you communicate by phone, text,
, or all three?



6. Describe your experience handling maintenance.



For example, did you receive tenant maintenance requests, contact contractors, schedule appointments, follow up with contractors, update work orders, and confirm completion with tenants?



7. SCENARIO



At 9:15 AM, a tenant calls and says water is actively leaking through the ceiling.



At the same time, you have a prospective tenant waiting for confirmation of a 10:00 AM apartment showing.



Explain exactly what you would do, step by step.



8. SCENARIO



You contacted a plumber yesterday about an open repair.



The plumber told you:



“I'll call you tomorrow morning.”



It is now 1:00 PM the next day and you have not heard from him.



What would you do?



9. SCENARIO



A tenant sends this message:



“Nobody ever responds to me. I've been waiting for someone to fix my sink and this is ridiculous.”



Write the exact response you would send to the tenant.



10. Are you currently employed or working for any other clients?



If yes, please explain your schedule and approximately how many hours per week you currently work.



11. What hours are you available to work in U.S. Eastern Time?



12. What monthly salary in USD are you requesting for a full-time position?



VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Please include a link to a 60–90 second voice recording.



In the recording:



Introduce yourself

Tell us about your previous property-management experience

Explain why you believe you would be a good fit for this position



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Finally, at the very bottom of your application, answer this question:



What is one responsibility from this job posting that you believe you would be especially good at, and why?



Please do NOT send us a generic cover letter.



We are not looking for someone who simply tells us:



“I am hardworking.”



“I am a fast learner.”



“I am detail-oriented.”



We want to see examples from your actual experience that demonstrate those qualities.



If you are looking for a serious, stable, long-term opportunity and have strong property-management experience, we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Senior Accounts Officer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Bookkeeper / Senior Accounts Officer to take full ownership of the accounting and bookkeeping function across three established eCommerce businesses. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are an essential requirement for this position. Please do not apply if you do not have a high level of English proficiency, as the role requires regular communication with management, team members and suppliers, both verbally and in writing.



This is a senior, hands-on role with sole responsibility for the day-to-day accounting function. We are looking for someone who is highly experienced, commercially minded, extremely accurate and capable of managing the accounts independently without requiring ongoing supervision.



This is a dedicated, hands-on position and subletting, outsourcing or delegating any part of your work to another person is strictly prohibited. You must personally perform all duties assigned to you and be available and contactable by phone throughout your working hours when required. 





Experts only should apply. The successful candidate will be expected to understand the full accounting cycle, identify discrepancies, maintain accurate financial records and ensure management has reliable and up-to-date financial information. We are a dropship/supplier fulfilment business model.



We are also looking for an exceptional problem solver, someone who does not simply identify an issue and pass it on, but takes ownership, investigates the cause and works independently to find an accurate and practical solution. You must be proactive, resourceful and confident working through accounting discrepancies and operational issues without requiring constant direction from management.



You will work closely with business management and external accountants where required, but you will be responsible for ensuring the businesses' accounts are accurate, reconciled and maintained at all times.



Key Responsibilities



Accounts Payable & Supplier Management

Match supplier invoices against purchase orders and business records

Enter, review and correctly allocate supplier invoices

Reconcile supplier statements against the accounting system

Mid Month Reconciliation for those supplier who can supply an interim statement

Credit Limit Reconciliation for suppliers who have limited credit facilities and our invoices reach this amount during the month

Investigate purchase orders on Shopfiy and  and resolve invoice, credit and statement discrepancies

Prepare and process supplier payment runs

Ensure supplier payments are made accurately and within agreed trading terms

Allocate supplier credits and adjustments correctly

Maintain accurate supplier account records

Monitor outstanding invoices and upcoming payment obligations

Communicate directly with suppliers regarding account discrepancies when required



Bank & Account Reconciliations

Complete regular bank reconciliations across multiple businesses and accounts

Reconcile credit cards and other payment accounts

Manage and reconcile clearing accounts

Investigate and resolve unreconciled or incorrectly allocated transactions

Ensure clearing and suspense accounts are regularly reviewed and cleared

Reconcile payment gateways and eCommerce payment methods where required

Ensure transactions between systems are correctly recorded and accounted for



Supplier Pricing & Cost Management

Maintain accurate supplier cost prices within relevant business systems

Update supplier pricing when new price lists or cost changes are received

Identify discrepancies between invoiced costs and recorded supplier costs

Ensure cost price changes are correctly reflected in internal systems

Monitor supplier price increases and significant changes that may affect margins

Work with management to identify potential margin or costing issues



Financial Reporting

Maintain an accurate and up-to-date general ledger

Prepare and review monthly Profit & Loss Statements

Prepare and review Balance Sheets

Ensure balance sheet accounts are properly reconciled and supported

Investigate unusual movements, discrepancies or incorrect account allocations

Assist management with understanding financial performance and significant variances

Maintain accurate financial records across all three businesses

Support month-end and year-end accounting processes

Prepare financial information and supporting documentation for external accountants as required



General Accounting Responsibilities

Take ownership of the complete bookkeeping and accounting function

Maintain the chart of accounts and ensure transactions are correctly classified

Process journals, accruals, prepayments and adjustments where required

Maintain accurate records for GST and other applicable tax obligations

Assist with BAS preparation and reporting requirements where applicable

Maintain accurate records of business assets and liabilities

Ensure intercompany transactions are correctly recorded and reconciled

Maintain organised supporting documentation and accounting records

Identify accounting errors and correct them proactively

Develop and improve accounting processes and internal controls where required



Systems & eCommerce Accounting

Our businesses operate in a high-volume eCommerce environment, so experience working with integrated accounting, inventory and eCommerce systems is highly desirable.

Experience with the following would be advantageous:

Xero

Shopify

Cin7 Core / DEAR

Payment gateways including Shopify Payments, Afterpay and Zip

Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets

Inventory-based accounting

Multi-business or multi-entity accounting

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are important. You should be comfortable working with large data sets, reconciliation spreadsheets, lookups, formulas and financial reports.



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone with significant bookkeeping/accounting experience who is comfortable being the primary person responsible for the accuracy of the accounts.

The ideal candidate will have:

Extensive experience as a Senior Bookkeeper, Accounts Officer or similar accounting role

Strong understanding of accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping

Experience managing accounts payable from invoice entry through to supplier payment

Strong reconciliation experience

Experience preparing and reviewing Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets

Experience reconciling balance sheet and clearing accounts

Strong understanding of accruals, prepayments, journals and general ledger accounting

Excellent attention to detail

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

The ability to identify discrepancies rather than simply process transactions

The confidence to investigate issues independently and take them through to resolution

Excellent organisational and time-management skills

The ability to manage accounting responsibilities across multiple businesses

Strong written English and professional communication skills

The ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Experience with eCommerce, inventory-based businesses or high-volume transaction environments will be highly regarded.

Seniority & Expectations

This role requires someone who can take genuine ownership of the accounting function.

We do not want someone who needs to be taught bookkeeping fundamentals or requires management to regularly check their work.

We are looking for someone who can look at a supplier statement, clearing account, balance sheet or P&L and recognise when something does not look right.

You should be comfortable investigating discrepancies, finding the cause, correcting the issue and implementing processes to prevent it from happening again.

Accuracy, accountability and initiative are critical to this position.



What Success Looks Like

The successful person will ensure:

Supplier invoices are entered accurately and promptly

Supplier statements are fully reconciled

Suppliers are paid correctly and on time

Bank and clearing accounts remain reconciled

Outstanding discrepancies are actively investigated and resolved

Supplier cost prices remain accurate

Balance sheet accounts are reconciled and supported

Profit & Loss reporting is accurate and current

Financial records across all three businesses are organised and reliable

Month-end accounts are completed consistently and on time

Management can rely on the financial information provided to make business decisions

Ultimately, we are looking for someone who can own the numbers across the businesses and ensure the accounting function runs accurately without needing to be managed day-to-day.

title: Manual QA tester needed for a SaaS product
description:
looking for a careful, detail-oriented Manual QA Tester to test our web application before we release new features to customers.



You do NOT need to write code. You do not need automation, Selenium, or programming experience. What we need is someone who will click through our app carefully, try to break it, and clearly report what went wrong.



This is a long-term, ongoing role. We want to work with the same person every week, not a one-time project.



What You Will Do:

1. Follow written test checklists we give you, step by step, in a web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari).

Record your screen with Loom (or others) while you test, so we can see exactly what happened.

2. Follow written checklists ensuring the normal functionality works

3. Try to break the app on purpose: enter wrong data, click buttons twice, use the back button, refresh in the middle of a form, try very long text, try special characters.

4. Write a short bug report for every problem you find, using our template (we will give you the template — you just fill in the fields).

5. Include the video timestamp for bugs

6. Re-test bugs after our developers fix them, to confirm the fix works.

7. Send a short daily summary of what you tested and what you found



What We Need From You

1. A reliable computer (Windows or Mac) and a stable internet connection

2. Ability to record your screen

3. Very careful attention to detail. This job is about noticing small things that look wrong.

4. Written English good enough to describe a problem clearly. It does not need to be perfect. Short, clear sentences are better than long ones. Feel free to use AI assistance to type clear, short sentence

5. Patience. Some days you will run the same checklist again to make sure nothing broke.

6. At least 2 hours per day, 3-5 days per week, if available to do testing over the weekend would be great (not often, but a short session)



Nice To Have (Not Required)

1. Previous QA or software testing experience.

2. Experience using Jira, Trello, Linear, Notion, or GitHub Issues.

3. Experience testing on multiple browsers



Extra Info:



1. ~15 hours per week to start, with the possibility of more hours later.

2. A clear, stable routine. You will know what to test and what is expected.

3. Very easy going team, asynchronous communications, do at your own pace.

4. A paid trial: before we hire you, we will pay you for a 2-hour test task on our real product. You get paid for this time whether or not we move forward.



How To Apply



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be read.

1. Put this exact word at the start of your subject line: BUGHUNT

2. Answer these three questions in your application. Keep each answer short - 1-3 sentences is enough.



Tell us about the last time you found a bug or a broken feature on any website or app you were using. What went wrong, and how would you explain it to a developer so they could reproduce it?



What computer, operating system, browser, and internet speed do you have? Have you recorded your screen before? If yes, with what tool?



What days and hours (Philippine time) can you work each week?



3. Optional: record a short Loom video (3 minutes or less) where you click around any public website and point out one thing that is broken, confusing, or badly designed. Paste the link in your application.

Our game AI systems are stable and tunable without constant engineer intervention, backend operations run reliably on autopilot with failures caught before players or staff notice, and leadership has clear weekly visibility on what you're building.



Who You Are

- You have built backend automation that real systems depended on, and you can talk about what broke

title: SMS Reviewer (Quality Control, Full Time)
description:
WHAT THIS JOB IS



We run an SMS service for online stores. When a shopper gets to the checkout

and leaves without finishing, our system writes them a short, personal text

message and offers to send their cart back to them.



Before any of those messages goes out, a person reads it and approves it.



That person is you.



You are the last check between our system and a real customer's phone. Nothing

sends without you.





WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Read each drafted message before it sends, then approve it or reject it

- Check it matches the right customer, the right store, and what is actually

  in their cart

- Reject anything that reads wrong: wrong name, wrong product, wrong tone, or

  a promise we do not make

- Tell us when the same mistake keeps appearing, so we can fix it at the source

- A few small tasks outside the queue now and then: simple data checks, short

  reports, tidying records



Most of your shift is reviewing and approving. We are being straight with you

about that. It is repetitive work.



The reason we pay a real rate for it is that we need someone who is still

reading properly in hour seven. One message that goes out wrong lands on a real

customer's phone with a real store's name on it. Catching that is the whole job.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent written English. You have to catch a sentence that reads slightly

  off, not just one with a typo in it.

- Good judgment. Some messages are fine. Some are almost fine. Knowing the

  difference is the skill.

- A reliable computer and a stable internet connection. This is not a job you

  can do from a phone.

- Able to commit to a fixed shift, six days a week, long term. We assign the

  shift, and it may be an overnight one.

- Attention that holds. You are looking for the one message in fifty that is

  wrong.

- Discretion. You will see customer names, phone numbers and order details.

  That stays private, always.



Helpful but not required: experience in ecommerce, customer support, quality

assurance, or as a virtual assistant.



You do not need to be technical. You do not need to write the messages. You

need to be able to tell when one is wrong.





HOURS AND PAY



- $3.00 USD per hour

- 8 hours a day, 6 days a week

- About $624 USD per month

- Paid weekly, via Wise or PayPal, whichever you prefer

- Long term and ongoing. This is not a short project.

- Start date: as soon as possible. We are ready to start the right person

  this week.



We cover the queue around the clock, so shifts are assigned by us rather than

chosen. Yours may be a daytime, evening or overnight shift in Manila time. Once

assigned it is fixed, so you will know your hours and they will not move week to

week.



Please only apply if you are able to work whichever shift you are given.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form. It takes about ten minutes:







Please do not message us here instead. Applications that do not come through

the form will not be read, and that is not us being difficult, it is that the

form asks the questions we actually need answered.



There is a short judgement test in it. That part is the job.
