description:
**Full-Time | Remote | starting $1,000 USD/month**



Den Defenders is looking for a **Social Media Content &  Growth Specialist** to help us get more out of the content we create.



We manufacture premium security doors and window screens and are investing heavily in organic social media. Our local content creator handles filming and creating content. **Your job is what happens after the content is created** — publishing, repurposing, testing, engaging with our audience, and turning attention into real conversations and leads.



This is **not** a basic “post three times a week” role. We want someone who understands social media, thinks creatively, pays attention to what is working, and constantly looks for ways to improve performance.



### What You'll Do



**Manage & Grow Social Accounts**



* Publish and schedule content across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms

* Manage Stories, comments, and DMs

* Keep accounts active, organized, and on-brand

* Engage with relevant communities, businesses, creators, and potential customers



**Repurpose & Edit Content**



* Turn existing content into multiple platform-specific versions

* Edit and shorten videos

* Create different hooks, captions, subtitles, covers, and thumbnails

* Create Reels, Shorts, Stories, and other variations



**Test & Improve Content**



* Test hooks, video lengths, captions, covers, CTAs, reposts, and alternate versions

* Track performance and identify what works

* Look for opportunities to improve reach, engagement, and leads



**Community & Lead Generation**



* Respond naturally to comments and DMs

* Answer basic questions and continue conversations with potential customers

* Identify and pass qualified leads to our sales team

* Participate in relevant
 groups, Reddit, LinkedIn, and local communities without being spammy



**Research & Social Listening**



* Monitor competitors, trends, customer questions, and conversations

* Identify common objections and questions that could become future content

* Share useful content ideas and opportunities with our content creator



### How We'll Measure Success



Our biggest KPI is **organic leads and customer conversations generated through social media.**



We'll also track:



* Meaningful comments and DMs

* Followers gained

* Engagement and shares

* Video views

* Content tests completed

* Winning content variations

* Leads and appointments generated when trackable



We care more about **reaching the right audience** than getting meaningless views.



### We're Looking For Someone Who



* Has real experience managing social media accounts

* Has strong short-form video editing skills

* Understands Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

* Writes naturally and conversationally in English

* Understands basic social media analytics

* Is comfortable testing new ideas

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Takes initiative without needing step-by-step instructions

* Has good judgment when representing a company online

* Understands the difference between genuine engagement and spam

* Has experience with tools such as **CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Meta Business Suite, and AI video tools**

* Is creative, persistent, and willing to figure things out when something doesn't work



Experience with **home improvement, construction, security, or other service-based businesses** is a plus.



### How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of social media accounts you've managed

3. **2–3 short-form videos you've personally edited**

4. A brief explanation of your work on each account/video

5. The social platform you understand best and why

6. Proof of organic social media growth you've achieved



**Video Question — Required**



In your application video, please answer:



> **Imagine we post a Reel showing someone trying to break through one of our security screens. It gets 75,000 views, 300 comments, and several people asking about the price. What would you do next?**



We're more interested in **how you think** than a perfectly formatted résumé or AI-generated answer.



### Compensation



**Starting salary: $1,000 USD/month**



* Performance-based salary review after 3 months

* Bi-weekly payment via PayPal or Payoneer

* 13th-month Christmas bonus

* Opportunity for compensation to grow as your impact grows



We're looking for someone who wants to **grow with the company and help build one of the strongest social media brands in our industry.**

title: Data Analyst
description:
Overview



We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Data Analyst to help us make sense of legacy data, clean it up, and coordinate the fixes needed to get it into shape. This isn't a narrow, single-skill role — we need someone comfortable wearing multiple hats: digging into messy datasets, spotting the root cause of problems, managing the process of fixing them, and communicating clearly with stakeholders along the way.

You'll be working primarily with historical data sets, identifying inconsistencies, errors, and gaps, and then driving a plan to resolve them — whether that means cleaning the data yourself, briefing others on what needs to change, or coordinating with Salesforce admins/developers to correct records at the source.



Key Responsibilities



• Audit & investigate old/legacy data to identify quality issues, inconsistencies, duplicates, and gaps

• Clean and structure data using Excel and other tools to bring it up to a usable standard

• Diagnose root causes of data problems (not just symptoms) and document findings clearly

• Coordinate fixes across teams or systems — acting as project manager for data remediation efforts, tracking progress, setting timelines, and following up

• Work within Salesforce to review, correct, and maintain data records

• Communicate findings and progress to non-technical stakeholders in plain, clear language

• Recommend and help implement processes to prevent future data quality issues

• Explore opportunities to use AI tools to speed up data cleaning, analysis, or pattern identification



Required Skills & Experience



• Proven experience as a data analyst, data cleaner, or similar role

• Excel expert — comfortable with formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data validation, and troubleshooting large/messy spreadsheets

• Strong project management skills — able to plan, prioritize, and see a fix through from diagnosis to resolution

• Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical data issues to non-technical stakeholders and coordinate across teams

• Experience working with Salesforce (data review, cleanup, reporting)

• Sharp analytical and problem-solving mindset — comfortable digging into "why is this wrong?" rather than just flagging that it is

• High attention to detail and a methodical approach to auditing data

• MUST own and use an Apple MacBook



Desirable



• Exposure to or interest in using AI tools (e.g., for data cleaning, pattern recognition, automation, or reporting)

• Experience with other data tools (SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, etc.)

• Background in coordinating cross-functional fixes involving IT, operations, or external vendors



What Success Looks Like



• Old/legacy data is audited, cleaned, and reliable

• Clear documentation of what was wrong, why, and how it was fixed

• Stakeholders are kept informed throughout, with minimal surprises

• Recommendations in place to reduce recurrence of similar issues

title: CREDIT DISPUTE SPECIALIST — REMOTE
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our growing team.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already understands the credit dispute process and can step into an established workflow without requiring extensive training on the fundamentals.

We will train you on our company's specific processes and SOPs, but you should already have a strong understanding of credit disputes and be comfortable working independently.



POSITION DETAILS

* Starting Rate: $10 per completed client file/round

* Trial Period: Paid trial

* Work Environment: 100% Remote

* Long-Term Opportunity: Consistent ongoing client files available for candidates who successfully complete the trial

* Growth Opportunity: We are building and expanding our dispute team, so there is room for increased responsibility as the company grows



This is a production-based role rather than an hourly position. Compensation is paid per client file/round completed accurately according to our SOPs and documentation requirements.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:

* DisputeFox

* CFPB complaints/disputes

* FTC reports/processes

* Experian backdoor methods/processes

* Credit report analysis

* Client documentation review

* Identity theft and factual dispute workflows

* Bureau dispute submissions

* Managing multiple client files simultaneously

* GoHighLevel or similar CRM systems



You should understand how to review a client's credit profile, identify inaccuracies and inconsistencies, determine the appropriate dispute strategy, properly document your work, and move files through the dispute process efficiently.



We will train you on how WE do things. We will not be training you on the fundamentals of credit disputes.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

* Is highly organized and detail-oriented

* Follows SOPs and instructions exactly

* Understands dispute strategy—not just how to generate letters

* Can manage multiple client files without becoming disorganized

* Works efficiently without sacrificing accuracy

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Communicates professionally with team members

* Takes accountability and ownership of their work

* Can receive feedback and make corrections quickly

* Does not require heavy training on basic credit dispute processes

* Is proactive and solution-oriented, not someone who simply waits for instructions

* Pays attention to patterns and results across client files and communicates what they notice

* Speaks up when something isn't working and comes prepared with possible solutions

* Recognizes what IS working and looks for opportunities to improve or build on it

* Thinks beyond simply completing the assigned task and looks for ways to improve results, efficiency, and processes



We value team members who think critically. If you notice a recurring issue, an opportunity to improve a process, or a strategy that appears to be producing strong results, we want you to speak up.



PRODUCTIVITY EXPECTATIONS



This is a production-based role.



As you become familiar with our internal processes, an initial benchmark will be approximately 5–8 completed client files/rounds per full working day, depending on file complexity and assigned workload.

Quality and accuracy come first. We are not looking for someone who rushes through client files simply to increase their completed-file count.



Your work will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality

* Dispute strategy

* Efficiency

* Ability to follow SOPs

* Organization and documentation

* Communication

* Reliability

* Initiative and problem-solving

* Overall client-file output



PAID TRIAL & TRAINING PROCESS

Candidates selected after the interview will begin with a paid trial period.

We will first walk you through our internal workflow and show you exactly how we expect client files to be handled.



You will then be assigned client files to complete using our process. During your initial trial files, your work will be reviewed at specific checkpoints before final submissions are made.



This may include review of:

* Dispute letters

* FTC documentation

* CFPB complaints

* File documentation

* Submission confirmations/screenshots



As you demonstrate accuracy, consistency, and a strong understanding of our process, you will be expected to complete files more independently with less supervision.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate your actual ability to perform the work, follow our processes, think critically, accept feedback, communicate effectively, and consistently produce accurate client files.

Candidates who successfully complete the trial may be offered consistent ongoing work with our dispute team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit ALL of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A 2–3 minute Loom/video introducing yourself and briefly explaining:

* Your previous credit dispute experience

* How long you've worked with DisputeFox

* Approximately how many client files you have managed at one time

* Your experience with CFPB and FTC processes

* Your general dispute workflow/process

3. Blurred/redacted screenshots demonstrating your experience inside relevant systems/platforms.

Do NOT include client names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, addresses, account numbers, credit report information, or any other sensitive client information.

4. Answer the following scenario:

“You receive a new client file containing collections, charge-offs, late payments, and inconsistent personal information across the three credit bureaus. Walk us through how you would review the file, determine what should be addressed first, and begin the dispute process.”



IMPORTANT

To confirm that you actually read this entire job post, put:

“CFPB READY”

at the very top of your application.



Applications that are missing the phrase, resume, video, screenshots, or written response will not be considered.

title: FULLTIME E-COM ADS EDITOR
description:
READ THIS FIRST — 30 SECONDS



We hire editors who cut e-commerce performance ads. Not videographers. Not wedding editors. Not "content creators".



If you have never edited a video that ran as a paid ad on TikTok or Meta for a product that had to sell, stop reading. You will not be shortlisted. We will both lose time.



We are not being rude — we are being clear. Last round we read every application and almost none of them had ever cut a real ad. So this posting is written to filter, hard.



If you have the skill, keep reading. This is a long-term seat with a rate that moves up fast.



WHO WE ARE



German e-commerce brand. Personalized gifts — engraved jewelry, name necklaces, photo pieces. We run paid traffic on TikTok and Meta every single day at real budget. Q4 is our season and creative volume is our bottleneck, not traffic.



You work directly with the owner. No agency layer, no account manager, no middleman.



THE JOB — TWO PARTS, YOU DO BOTH

1. Cut variations at volume

Take one raw video and build 8–12 testable variations from it

Change hooks, first 3 seconds, text overlays, captions, music, pacing, CTA

9:16 vertical, safe-zone framing for TikTok and Meta, clean exports

Work from our written briefs and reference ads

2. Source your own raw material



This is the part most applicants cannot do — and the reason the rate climbs quickly for the person who can.



We onboard you properly. In week one you get our briefs, our brand rules, our winning ads, our folder structure and our sources. After that, finding material is your job, not ours. We are not going to hand you a footage folder every Monday.



Hunt in the Meta Ad Library and TikTok Creative Center: find what is running and working in our niche, break down why the first 3 seconds work, rebuild that structure with our product

Find usable footage yourself: creator/UGC clips, licensed stock, our product library, and footage you specifically request from us

Reference means structure, hook and pacing — never re-uploading someone else's footage as ours. We do not run stolen material.

Bring hook ideas we did not ask for



Output: 20–40 finished variations per week, consistently.



BIG PLUS: AI VIDEO



We are strongly interested in editors who already work with AI video models — Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, Hailuo, Midjourney and whatever you use. Generating usable b-roll, product scenes, UGC-style shots and hook openers with AI is where a large part of our creative volume is going.



This is not a requirement. But if you can do it well, say so clearly in your application — it moves you to the top of the list and it moves your rate.



NON-NEGOTIABLES

You have cut short-form ads for e-commerce products before and you can prove it

Clean work: correct aspect ratio, captions timed to the audio and readable on a phone, no letterboxing, no watermarks, no sloppy exports

Our copy is German. We give you the exact text — you copy-paste it, never retype it. A German typo you cannot spot kills the ad.

Deadlines hold. Blocked → you tell us the same day, not the next morning

Feedback gets applied to the next batch. We do not repeat ourselves twice.

Short daily update on what you finished

Consistent file naming and delivery into our folder structure — we should never have to ask which version is which

Stable internet, a machine that actually renders, and at least 3 hours of daily overlap with 09:00–18:00 CET (from roughly 15:00 Philippine time)

DO NOT APPLY IF

Your portfolio is weddings, vlogs, corporate films, event recaps or showreels

Your only "ad work" is practice edits that never ran as a paid ad

You need a brief for every single decision

You are juggling three other clients and this would be your filler work

You cannot show us your own project timeline for the work you send

PAY

4.50 USD/hour, 25 hours/week (112 USD/week)

Paid weekly, every week, on time. No delays, no excuses.

Performance bonus: 20 USD for every variation that becomes a winner in the account (beats our control on CPA at meaningful spend). The right editor earns more from bonuses than from hours.

Rate and hours go up once your output and hit rate are proven — this is not a "maybe later", it is how we have run every seat

Long term. We are building for years, not for one campaign.



Reliable payment is not a given in this market. Ours is.



HOW TO APPLY



Anything missing from this list gets deleted unread. That is intentional — it is the filter.



1. First word of your message: BURGUNDY42



2. Three links to short-form ADS you personally edited. 9:16 vertical, TikTok / Reels / Meta only. For each one, one line: what product, which platform it ran on, and what you were going for in the first 3 seconds.



3. Proof the work is yours. A 60-second screen recording (Loom or unlisted YouTube) with one of those three projects open on your timeline in your editor. We want to see the layers and the cuts — not the finished video again.



4. Answer these, short, in your own words:



Which editing software do you use daily, and how exactly do you do captions?

How many finished variations can you realistically deliver from one raw video in one 8-hour day — and what slows you down past that number?

We give you no footage for a batch. Where do you get raw material? Name your three go-to sources.

Link one e-commerce ad you have seen recently that works, and tell us in two sentences why its first 3 seconds work.

Do you work with AI video models? If yes: which ones, and what do you actually use them for in an ad? If no, write "no" — we would rather know.

What is your current work situation — which clients do you have right now, and how many hours per week are actually free?



5. Two references. Name and contact 
, 
 or
) of two clients or employers you have edited for. We do contact them. If you cannot give references, say why.



6. Your internet speed (screenshot), your computer specs, and your available working hours in Philippine time.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We reply within 48 hours. We move fast and we expect the same.

We check your work and we call your references.

Google Meet with the owner. Camera on. We want to talk to you, not to a CV.

There is no test task. We do not make people work for free and we do not hand out little trial projects. Your first week is the test — fully paid, fully onboarded, real briefs, real ads. If the output is there, you stay long-term and the rate starts moving. If it is not, we end it cleanly after week one and you keep your money.

Start: immediately.

title: Wedding Video Editor
description:
Haze Photo and Film is a wedding photography and videography studio based in Australia looking for a freelance video editor for ongoing, per-project work. We handle all filming. You'll receive raw footage and edit it into finished wedding films.



**How it works:**



We send you the raw footage and audio from each wedding. Before editing, we'll debrief the day with you by call or
 and give you direction on story, tone, standout moments to build the edit around and priorities from the couple. 



**Responsibilities:**



- Review raw footage and audio from each wedding alongside our debrief notes, then build an edit that reflects the direction we've given on story, tone, and key moments.

- Sync multicam footage from ceremonies, receptions, and speeches, along with separate audio from lav and room mics to create Documentary films and Ceremony/Speeches Films

- Colour grade and colour correct footage shot across varying light, from outdoor ceremonies to dim reception venues, so the whole film feels visually consistent.

- Choose music that matches the couple's taste and the emotional beats of the day, from quiet vow moments to high energy reception cuts.

- Structure the edit for pacing, deciding what stays, what gets trimmed, and how scenes flow into each other to tell a cohesive story.

- Cut multiple deliverables from the same footage, including a highlight film, a longer documentary style edit, and short vertical cuts for social media.

- Organise and manage large volumes of raw footage without losing or mixing up files between projects. Take feedback from us and the couple and turn revision notes into a refined final cut within the agreed timeline.



**Requirements:**



At least 1 year prior experience editing wedding films, with a portfolio to show. Fluent in written and spoken English. Fluent in DaVinci Resolve. Strong musicality and a natural sense of storytelling, this role leans heavily on music selection and pacing. Experience with multicam and audio syncing. Comfortable transferring and managing large video files (Dropbox, Google Drive, LucidLink, or similar). Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.



**Details:**



Freelance, ongoing per-project work. Rate to be discussed based on experience and turnaround.

description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

D. $250 partnership bonus when a partnership you originated or materially managed goes live AND at least $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). An announcement or deployment with no qualifying mints does not pay

E. Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

F. No cap on appointment bonuses. One bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

G. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

H. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Short-Form Creative Designer (Figma)
description:
About Zylo



Zylo (zylo.solutions) is an AI-powered short-form video production agency helping ecommerce brands and local businesses create high-volume UGC-style video ads that actually convert. We combine AI-generated footage with sharp creative direction to produce scroll-stopping content at scale — fast, organized, and built to perform.



We're growing and looking for a creative designer to support our production pipeline with visual assets, templates, and design work that makes our video content and brand presence sharper across the board.



The Role



We're looking for a detail-oriented, fast-moving graphic designer who can work in Figma and produce clean, on-brand visual assets to support video ad production and client deliverables. This is a part-time remote role, production-minded and output-focused - you'll be working within a system, not just making things look pretty.



What You'll Be Doing:



Designing static and animated ad assets for Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts

Creating caption overlays, text templates, and graphic elements for video ad production

Building and maintaining reusable Figma templates for recurring content formats

Designing client-facing assets: thumbnails, cover images, story frames, and ad mockups

Supporting the production team with brand-consistent visual elements across batches

Keeping files organized, named correctly, and easy for editors to work with

Catching visual issues: off-brand colors, inconsistent fonts, misaligned elements, low-res exports



What We're Looking For:



Solid Figma experience - you know components, auto-layout, and how to build templates others can actually use

Strong eye for short-form social content - you understand what makes a thumb-stopping visual

Fast and organized -this is a volume role, not a "one beautiful piece per week" role

Comfortable working inside a repeatable production system with clear briefs and brand guidelines

Bonus: experience with motion graphics, After Effects, or animated assets for social ads

Bonus: experience with ecommerce or DTC brand design, UGC-style content, or performance ad creative



Volume & Hours:



Approximately 50 design assets per month

Part-time, ~25 hours/month

Remote, flexible hours - output matters more than when you work



To Apply, Please Answer These Questions:



What design tools do you use day-to-day, and what's your Figma experience level?

Share a portfolio link - ideally showing social media, ad creative, or short-form content design work

Have you designed assets specifically for paid ads (Meta, TikTok, Instagram)? If yes, describe a project and what your role was

How do you handle working across multiple clients or brands with different guidelines simultaneously?

What does your process look like when you receive a brief - walk us through how you go from brief to finished asset?

What's your timezone and availability?



One last thing: Tell us your favourite city in your application or it won't be considered



Ideal Person:

A fast, detail-oriented creative who moves between briefs cleanly, understands that design here is in service of performance (not just aesthetics), and can keep a high volume of assets moving through a pipeline without dropping quality.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video EditorShort-Form Video Editor



About Zylo



Zylo is an AI-powered video production agency. We produce short-form video content for two types of clients: ecommerce/DTC brands that need high-converting UGC-style ad content for Meta and TikTok, and local businesses that need social media content to promote their services and grow their online presence. We combine AI-generated footage with sharp editing and direct-response ad structure to deliver videos at volume - built to perform, not just look good.

The Role



We're looking for a fast, detail-oriented short-form video editor to help produce high-volume UGC-style video ads for ecommerce brands and local businesses. You'll take scripts, AI-generated footage, product assets, and creative direction, then turn them into polished vertical videos ready for Meta, TikTok, Reels, and client delivery.



What you'll do



-Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta ads, and YouTube Shorts

-Add clean captions, hooks, text overlays, sound effects, music, cuts, zooms, and pacing

-Apply direct-response ad structure: hook, problem, product, benefit, proof, CTA

-Polish AI-generated footage - remove awkward timing, dead air, bad transitions, or unusable 
nts

-Follow brand guidelines, script instructions, and client feedback accurately

-Export videos in 9:16, with clean naming and organized files

-Spot issues like misspelled text, fake-looking captions, bad AI hands/faces, awkward product shots, or off-brand visuals

-Work quickly across batches of 25–200 videos per month



Bonus skills



-Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, 
, Google Drive, or Notion/ClickUp.

Ideal person



-A production-minded editor who moves fast, follows systems, has good taste, and understands that these videos are meant to perform, not just look pretty.



***Application Questions***



1. What editing software/platforms do you primarily use? (CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, etc.)

2. Can you share a portfolio or reel of short-form/UGC-style videos you've edited? (Link please)

3. Have you edited ads specifically (vs. general content)? If so, for what kind of brands/products?

4.Have you worked with AI-generated footage before? If yes, what kind of cleanup did that typically involve?

5. Are you comfortable working across multiple client batches at once with different brand guidelines?

6. What's your availability/timezone, and how many hours per week are you looking for?



Please mention your favourite car brand in your application, or you will not be considered.

title: UGC & Short-Form Video Creator / Editor, You tube professional
description:
Remote | Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity



Quote based on fixed deliverables that you can produce instead of quoting an hourly rate.



Premium Home Décor & European Textile Brand



We are looking for a creative, experienced UGC Video Creator/Video Editor in the Philippines to join our team on an ongoing basis.



We sell premium European home décor products, including Belgian cushion covers, European jacquard tapestries, table runners, tassels, and other high-quality textile décor products.



We already have a large collection of professional product photographs, lifestyle images and some video footage.



Your job will be to turn these existing assets into high-quality, engaging videos that look professional, authentic, and designed to generate sales.



This is not simply a basic video-editing position. We are looking for someone who can bring creative ideas and help us determine what type of video content will work best on Amazon and social media.



What You Will Do



You will create content for:



Amazon

Instagram Reels


TikTok

YouTube Shorts

Pinterest

YouTube — if you have the experience

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Create UGC-style product videos from our existing images and footage

Turn still photographs into attractive, dynamic videos

Create short-form videos/Reels/Shorts

Add professional text, captions, music, transitions, and effects

Create voiceover videos when appropriate

Develop different hooks and concepts for the same product

Create videos that explain product features and benefits

Create lifestyle and inspirational home décor content

Create product demonstration videos

Create videos suitable for Amazon listings

Repurpose content into different formats for different platforms

Suggest new video concepts based on current social media trends

We Also Have Limited Video Footage



This is important:



You do NOT need to receive professionally filmed video for every project.



We have many excellent still images and some video footage.



We need someone who is very good at creating videos from still photography and limited video assets.



For example, we may give you:



10–20 product photographs

2–3 lifestyle photographs

A short product video

Product information



We expect you to turn those materials into multiple engaging pieces of content.



UGC Experience



UGC experience is strongly preferred.



If you can also:



Appear on camera

Demonstrate products

Create authentic UGC

Record yourself using home décor products

Provide professional voiceovers



That is a major advantage.



However, appearing on camera is not mandatory.



YouTube Experience — PLUS



YouTube experience is a strong advantage but not required.



If you have experience creating longer-form YouTube videos, we may also use you to develop:



Home décor videos

Decorating ideas

Product education

Buying guides

European design stories

"How to style your home" videos

Product comparison videos

Longer product storytelling videos



We are interested in developing a YouTube channel over time, so experience in this area could lead to additional work.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who understands:



HOOK → STORY → PRODUCT → BENEFIT → CALL TO ACTION



You should understand how to make someone stop scrolling within the first few seconds.



We want videos that are:



Visually attractive

Premium

Authentic

Interesting

Not overly "salesy"

Suitable for a luxury home décor brand

Designed to generate engagement and ultimately sales

AI Skills Are Highly Desired



You should be comfortable using modern AI tools to improve productivity and creativity.



Experience with tools such as:



ChatGPT

Gemini

AI video tools

AI voiceover tools

AI image/video animation

CapCut

Canva

Adobe Premiere Pro

After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

Other current AI/video tools



is a plus.



We are not looking for generic AI-generated videos.



We want someone who knows how to combine AI + professional editing + creativity + good judgment.



Most Important Qualification



We are looking for someone who can look at a folder of product photographs and say:



"I have 5 different ideas for how we can turn these images into engaging videos."



You should be able to develop your own concepts rather than waiting for us to tell you exactly what to do.



Potential Monthly Work



We would like to develop a long-term monthly relationship with the right freelancer.



Depending on your experience and the agreed monthly package, work could include:



10–20+ short-form videos per month

Multiple creative variations

Amazon videos

Instagram/Facebook Reels

TikTok videos

YouTube Shorts

Occasional longer YouTube videos

Content repurposing



The exact volume will depend on your experience, quality and proposed monthly rate.



Compensation



We are open to either:



Hourly / project basis OR a fixed monthly retainer.



Please provide your preferred pricing structure.



For example:



Price per short-form video

Price for 5 videos

Price for 10 videos

Monthly package

Price for longer YouTube videos



We are looking for excellent value, not necessarily the lowest price.



Quality, creativity, reliability and long-term performance are more important than simply having the lowest rate.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your Portfolio



Provide links to your best UGC, Reels, TikTok, Amazon or e-commerce videos.



2. Examples Using Still Images



This is very important.



Please provide at least 2 examples where you created an engaging video primarily from photographs or limited video footage.



3. YouTube Work



If you have YouTube experience, provide examples.



4. Your Tools



Tell us which editing, AI and video-production tools you use.



5. Pricing



Please provide:



Per-video rate

10-video package

Monthly retainer, if available

6. Availability



Tell us:



Hours available per week

Current workload

Typical turnaround time

7. UGC



Tell us whether you:



Appear on camera

Create voiceovers

Can film original UGC

Work only as an editor/creator

PAID TEST PROJECT



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small paid test project using product images that we provide.



The purpose is to evaluate:



Creativity

Editing quality

Storytelling

Understanding of UGC

Ability to make still images interesting

Quality of hooks

Attention to detail

Understanding of premium branding



We are interested in building a long-term relationship with one or more talented creators, so there is potential for consistent monthly work for the right person.



We Want a Creative Partner — Not Just an Editor



If you are someone who can say:



"Here is an idea I think will sell this product better."



rather than simply:



"Tell me what video you want me to make."



—we would love to hear from you.



Please apply with your portfolio, pricing and examples of your best work.

title: Content Writer Local SEO Focus
description:
Fence & Deck Marketers is a digital marketing agency serving fencing, decking, and outdoor-living contractors across the United States. We are hiring a Content Strategist who can plan and produce content that ranks, gets cited, and brings in leads for local service businesses.



About the Role:



You will own Local SEO content strategy across our client accounts. That means d
 what gets written, what gets updated, what gets deleted, and why, based on data rather than guesswork.



You report to the SEO Manager, who sets the guidelines and gives you direction on how we work. Inside those guidelines, we want your thinking. Your main contribution is your own understanding of how content builds a client's brand and supports their marketing as a whole, not just how it ranks in search.



This is a lead role. You may have one to two people under you, so you will delegate tasks, build training for them, and review everything they produce before it goes out.



Using AI is expected. Using AI without a system is not. We already have our own system in place, and we will train you. We still want to see that you have built one of your own: your own prompt guidelines, templates, and quality checks, and the ability to explain why you built them that way. That tells us we are hiring someone who thinks about the work, not someone who just uses AI. If your workflow is opening a chat window and asking for a blog post, this is not the role for you.



What You Will Work On:



You will create strategy for and produce:



Blog posts

Press releases written to earn citations, including from AI search

Home page copy

Service page copy

Location page copy

Social media content (a significant part of this role)

Reddit posts

Google Business Profile content



What You Will Be Responsible For



Quality assurance. This is the most important part of the job. Every piece of content that leaves the team goes through you. You catch spelling errors, grammar errors, factual mistakes, and anything that does not follow client or agency guidelines. Nothing ships with errors on it.



Team leadership. You delegate work to one or two team members, create training and documentation so they improve, and give feedback that raises the standard of what they write.



Local SEO content. You understand how local search works and how localized content differs from national content. You know what a homeowner in a specific city needs to see before they call a contractor.



Content audits and decisions. You can look at an existing blog library and d
 which posts to target, which to refresh, which to consolidate, and which to remove.



Data analysis. You are comfortable reading Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Google Trends, and running keyword research in Ahrefs. You can turn that data into a content plan.



Local research. You dig into the market, the competitors, and the area before writing, rather than producing content that could apply to any city.



Topical authority and entity-based content. You understand how entities and topical coverage affect visibility, and you build content that strengthens both.



You will not be figuring all of this out on your own. Your SEO Manager already knows this work well, so the two of you collaborate on these tasks.



Requirements:



1) 3 to 5 years of content writing experience, specifically in local SEO or local markets

2) Experience editing and quality checking other writers' work, with an eye for spelling and grammar

3) Experience leading, training, or delegating to a small team is a strong advantage

4) A portfolio of published content you have written, with links

5) Hands-on experience with Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Google Trends

6) Excellent written and spoken English

7) Availability Monday to Friday during Eastern Time business hours



Hiring Process:



Apply with your resume and content samples



Shortlisted candidates receive a skills assessment



Candidates who pass the assessment move to an interview

title: U.S. Corporate Compliance & UCC Specialist – Washington State
description:
Full-Time | Remote – Philippines

U.S. Pacific Time / Night Shift

₱45,000–₱60,000 PHP per month Depending on experience



**This is NOT a Virtual Assistant position.**



A U.S.-based public records and corporate compliance company established in 2002, is seeking an **experienced U.S. corporate compliance, corporate paralegal, UCC, or public-records professional** to join our Washington State operations.



We are specifically looking for someone who already has hands-on experience **preparing and processing U.S. corporate forms, filings, document requests, or related legal/compliance work**.



Ideal candidates will have prior experience with a U.S. law firm, corporate services company, registered-agent provider, title/public-record research company, compliance organization, or similar professional services company.



**Washington-specific experience is preferred but not required.  We are looking for someone who already understands professional U.S. corporate/legal processing.**



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for preparing, processing, tracking, and completing corporate and public-record requests, including:



* LLC and corporation formations

* Foreign registrations

* Amendments

* Annual reports

* Dissolutions and withdrawals

* Registered-agent changes

* Officer, manager, governor, and address changes

* Certificates of existence/status

* Certified copies and corporate document requests

* Secretary of State filings and requests

* Washington Department of Revenue research and filings

* UCC searches and filings

* UCC amendments, continuations, assignments, and terminations

* Registered-agent matters

* Public-record and lien research

* Government follow-up

* Order tracking and quality control



You must be able to read a client request, determine what form or filing is required, accurately prepare the documents, identify missing information, submit the request to the correct government agency, follow it through completion, and review the final result for accuracy.



Experience We Are Looking For



Strong candidates will have at least **1–3 years of directly relevant U.S. experience** in one or more of the following:



* Corporate compliance

* Corporate paralegal work

* Secretary of State filings

* Business entity maintenance

* Registered-agent services

* UCC searches or filings

* Title/public-record research

* Corporate due diligence

* Legal document retrieval

* Government filings



Experience actually preparing and submitting corporate forms is strongly preferred.



Required Skills



You must have:



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong online research ability

* Experience reading legal and government documents

* Ability to prepare forms accurately

* Strong Microsoft Outlook and Word skills

* Working Excel skills

* Strong organization and follow-through

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. government offices



This position requires **research, judgment, accuracy, and ownership**. We need someone who recognizes when something does not look right and investigates rather than guesses.



If your experience is primarily general VA work, social media, lead generation, appointment setting, customer service, calendar management, or basic data entry, this position is not the right fit.



Schedule



Full-time, 40 hours per week during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours**.



This is a Philippine night-shift position.



Compensation



**₱45,000–₱55,000 PHP per month depending on directly relevant experience and demonstrated capability.**



How to Apply



Start your application with:



**WASHINGTON SPECIALIST**



Please send:



1. Your resume.

2. A short description of your U.S. corporate, legal, UCC, or public-record experience.

3. Tell us which **corporate forms, filings, or government requests you have personally prepared and processed**.

4. List the U.S. states you have worked with.

5. Confirm that you can work U.S. Pacific Time.

6. Provide a brief 60–90 second video introduction.



Also answer:



**You receive a corporate filing request you have never handled before. How would you determine the correct form, required information, supporting documents, filing method, and government fee before submitting it?**



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical corporate filing and research exercise.



We are looking for someone who already understands U.S. corporate/legal processing and wants to develop deeper expertise in Washington State work and grow with AADS long-term.

title: Amazon & E-commerce Marketplace Operations Specialist (Full-Time Remote)
description:
About the Role



We are a growing eCommerce company specializing in developing and selling consumer products through major online marketplaces. We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Amazon & E-commerce Marketplace Operations Specialist with at least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central to support our daily marketplace operations.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, has strong attention to detail, and can work independently while following processes and taking ownership of assigned tasks. Candidates should have practical experience with Amazon Seller Central, FBA operations, Amazon flat files/bulk uploads, listing updates, and troubleshooting listing issues.



Experience with other eCommerce marketplaces such as Walmart, eBay, Shopify, TikTok Shop, or similar platforms is a plus.



This is a full-time remote position for a Filipino candidate who is committed, reliable, and looking for a long-term opportunity with a growing eCommerce business.



Key Responsibilities

Marketplace & Listing Management

* Create, update, and maintain product listings on Amazon and other marketplaces

* Manage listing updates, content changes, and marketplace requirements

* Use Amazon flat files/bulk upload templates to create or update listings and troubleshoot upload errors

* Monitor listings for errors, missing information, and assist with resolving suppressed listings or other listing issues

* Assist with listing changes, image updates, and information corrections when required



Customer Service Support

* Respond to customer inquiries across all marketplaces professionally and efficiently

* Handle customer concerns, refunds, replacements, and order-related issues

* Monitor customer feedback and reviews

* Provide customer service support during scheduled weekend shifts

* Escalate complex issues when required



Operations Support

* Prepare reports and maintain operational documents

* Assist with compliance-related tasks and marketplace requests

* Perform research and data collection when needed

* Support other operational activities as required



Requirements

- At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central

- Experience with Amazon listings, variations, account health, FBA operations, flat files/bulk uploads, and troubleshooting listing issues

- Experience with customer service operations

- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to follow processes while working independently

- Strong sense of commitment, ownership, and integrity with a proactive approach to completing tasks and responsibilities

- Good written and verbal English communication skills

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, and online tools

- Experience with other eCommerce marketplaces such as Walmart, eBay, Shopify, or TikTok Shop is a plus



How to Apply

To apply, please send your updated resume/CV and a cover letter via
 Messenger explaining your 
/Amazon experience, why you are suitable for this role, examples of Amazon tasks or issues you have handled, and your availability for the required schedule.



Please also answer the following questions in your message:



1. How many years of hands-on experience do you have with Amazon Seller Central?

2. Have you used Amazon flat files or bulk upload templates before? Please describe what type of updates you have completed.

3. Have you handled Amazon listing issues such as suppressed listings, upload errors, inactive listings, or other account issues? Please provide an example.

title: Influencer Campaign Coordinator
description:
Producer Labs is a music marketing agency in Los Angeles.



We're hiring a Campaign Coordinator to support two of our campaign managers. When a label sends over a song and a budget, you're the person who turns that into creators booked, drafts collected, and posts live on schedule.



This is a graveyard shift. You must be online and reachable 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Pacific Time, which is about 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time. Please only apply if you can commit to those hours long-term.



How the business works: a brand or label comes to us with a budget and a song. That budget gets allocated to creators on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube who post with the track. We don't manage creators — we build relationships and deploy them on campaigns. You'll be in the middle of that, talking to creators every day.



We're an early, fast-moving team, so the scope of this role will shift as we grow. It suits someone who wants more on their plate over time, takes on new problems without waiting for perfect instructions, and treats being handed more responsibility as the point, not the burden.



What you'll do



Build and vet creator lists for active campaigns, and help put together the proposal that goes back to the client

Run creator outreach and negotiation over DM and
 — pitch, agree a rate, confirm the booking

Chase drafts and posts: get ETAs, check content against the brief, follow up until it's live

Swap out creators who go quiet or fall through, and refill the slot before the deadline moves

Keep 15–20 live campaigns current in Airtable so anyone can see where each one stands

Raise stuck campaigns early with what you've already tried and what you need



Must-haves



2+ years in campaign support, coordination, or a VA role with real outreach volume

Strong written English — you'll be pitching creators and sitting in client chats

Comfortable on video calls, and comfortable being the person who raises a problem

Organized across many campaigns at once without dropping follow-ups

Can commit to the graveyard shift long-term

Reliable power and internet, with a backup plan for outages



Nice-to-haves



Music marketing, influencer marketing, or creator-economy experience

Deck-building in Gamma, Canva, or Google Slides

Airtable, 
, Slack



To apply, send one outreach message you've actually sent to a creator or partner, and tell us what happened next. Shortlisted applicants will get a short Google Form before a 20-minute video interview.

title: TikTok Operator (Shop & Account)
description:
We are looking for an experienced TikTok Operator to take ownership of our U.S. TikTok operations and develop the channel into a profitable and scalable source of revenue. This is a commercial e-commerce role, not simply a social media or content-posting position. You will oversee the full TikTok channel, including TikTok Shop, creators and affiliates, short form content, paid advertising, livestreaming, promotions, analytics, and profitability. We are looking for someone with proven experience launching TikTok operations from the ground up or significantly scaling an existing TikTok channel. The role will initially be hands-on, with the opportunity to build and manage a TikTok team as the channel grows.





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

 with the subject:



Outbound Caller Application – [Your Full Name]

title: Operations & Revenue Manager
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Monday–Friday | 8 Hours/Day

Pay: $1,500 USD/month | Paid twice monthly



I’m looking for an experienced Operations & Revenue Manager to become the right hand behind the day-to-day operations and growth of my company.



This is NOT a traditional VA position.



I’m not looking for someone who needs a daily list of tasks or waits for me to tell them what needs to be done.



I’m looking for someone who can look at the business as a whole, identify where we’re losing time or money, improve our systems, and help us create a smoother operation that supports more revenue.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Oversee and optimize our day-to-day business operations

* Manage and improve our GoHighLevel CRM, pipelines, workflows, and automations

* Identify gaps in our lead follow-up and sales processes

* Build automated lead nurture and follow-up systems

* Create reactivation campaigns for old and unconverted leads

* Track leads throughout the customer journey and make sure opportunities aren’t falling through the cracks

* Analyze our funnels and identify where leads are dropping off

* Help develop upsells, renewals, cross-sells, and customer ascension opportunities

* Improve client onboarding, retention, and follow-up systems

* Review business processes and recommend ways to make them more efficient

* Track important KPIs and provide clear weekly reports on what’s working, what’s not, and what we should improve

* Bring new ideas and opportunities to the table without waiting to be asked

* Turn strategies and ideas into actual systems that are implemented and maintained



You May Be a Great Fit If…



* You have strong, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel

* You understand CRM systems, workflows, triggers, pipelines, tags, SMS/email automations, forms, and funnels

* You understand sales funnels and the customer journey

* You naturally look for inefficiencies, missed opportunities, and revenue leaks

* You understand lead nurturing, reactivation, retention, upsells, and conversion

* You’re comfortable working with numbers and tracking KPIs

* You can take an idea or strategy and figure out how to implement it

* You are proactive, resourceful, organized, and solution-oriented

* You can work independently without needing constant direction

* You’ve helped improve operations or revenue inside a service-based or online business before



This Role Is NOT For You If…



* You need detailed instructions for every task

* You wait until someone tells you there’s a problem

* Your experience is primarily basic administrative VA work

* You’ve only used GoHighLevel at a beginner level

* You can recommend strategies but cannot implement them

* You’re uncomfortable being held accountable to measurable results



What Success Looks Like



I want to be able to step away from manually managing every lead, follow-up, pipeline, and backend process and know that the business is still moving.



Your job is to help us build and manage the systems that make that possible.



You’ll constantly be thinking:



Where are we losing leads?

Where are we leaving money on the table?

What can be automated?

What can be improved?

What should happen next in the customer’s journey?



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. How many years of experience do you have managing operations for an online or service-based business?

2. Describe your experience with GoHighLevel. What have you personally built or managed inside the platform?

3. Tell me about a time you identified a problem or revenue opportunity in a business without being asked to look for it. What did you notice, what did you change, and what was the result?

4. Imagine you enter our CRM and discover 1,000 old leads who expressed interest but never purchased. Walk me through what you would do.

5. You notice the owner is manually following up with leads every day and those follow-ups are generating sales. What would you do?

6. Tell me about a system, automation, funnel, or process you personally created that improved revenue, conversions, retention, or efficiency. What were the results?

7. What KPIs would you track weekly if your responsibility was improving the operations and revenue of an online service business?

8. What’s one example of something you implemented in a previous company that the owner did NOT ask you to implement?

9. Are you available to work 8 hours per day, Monday–Friday?

10. Are you comfortable with a starting salary of $1,500 USD per month, paid twice monthly?



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “REVENUE & OPERATIONS” so I know you read the entire posting.



Generic or AI-generated answers that don’t clearly explain your personal experience will not be considered.

title: Sales Closer & Outbound Outreach Specialist
description:
Company: Dengcore

Position: Sales Closer & Outbound Outreach Specialist

Employment Type: Part-Time / Long-Term Opportunity

Work Location: Remote

Hours: Flexible, with availability during North American business hours preferred

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate + performance-based incentives/commission



About Dengcore

Dengcore is a growing professional services company focused on providing project management, administrative support, help desk, business consulting, and other professional services to government and enterprise clients.

We are looking for an experienced Sales Closer & Outbound Outreach Specialist who can take ownership of the front end of our sales process—from identifying prospects and making outbound calls to qualifying decision-makers, conducting sales conversations, following up, and ultimately helping convert qualified opportunities into clients.

This is not a passive customer-service position. We need someone confident, persuasive, professional, persistent, and comfortable speaking directly with business owners, executives, procurement professionals, and decision-makers.



The Role

You will be responsible for generating and developing sales opportunities through cold calling, outbound outreach, follow-ups, and sales calls.

The ideal candidate understands that successful sales requires consistent activity, strong communication, intelligent follow-up, and the ability to handle rejection without losing motivation.

You must be comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with people you have never contacted before.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Outbound Prospecting

Make consistent outbound calls to potential clients and business partners.

Contact companies, government contractors, prime contractors, and other relevant organizations.

Introduce Dengcore and clearly explain our services.

Identify the correct decision-maker within an organization.

Qualify prospects based on their needs, current projects, and potential fit.

Conduct follow-up calls with prospects who have previously shown interest.

Leave professional voi
s and send follow-up
s when appropriate.

Maintain consistent outreach activity every working day.



2. Sales & Closing

Conduct discovery calls with qualified prospects.

Understand the prospect’s business needs and identify opportunities where Dengcore can provide value.

Build rapport quickly with decision-makers.

Present Dengcore’s services professionally and confidently.

Handle objections regarding pricing, timing, competition, budget, and other concerns.

Move qualified prospects toward the next step in the sales process.

Schedule meetings and demonstrations when a prospect requires additional discussion.

Take sales calls and, when appropriate, close the opportunity yourself.

Follow up relentlessly but professionally until the prospect gives a clear yes or no.

Keep prospects moving through the sales pipeline.



3. Lead Follow-Up

Follow up with previous leads and prospects.

Re-engage prospects who stopped responding.

Track conversations and next steps.

Make sure no qualified lead is forgotten.

Maintain accurate notes in our CRM or tracking system.



4. Research & Lead Development

Research companies and identify potential prospects.

Find decision-makers and relevant contact information.

Review company websites, LinkedIn profiles, procurement information, and other available sources.

Help identify new markets and potential client segments.

Provide feedback on which industries and prospects appear most promising.



What We Are Looking For

MUST HAVE: Fluent English

Fluent spoken English is a strict requirement.

You must be able to:

Speak English fluently and naturally.

Communicate clearly with North American clients.

Understand different accents and speaking styles.

Explain complex ideas in simple language.

Speak confidently on the phone without constantly searching for words.

Sound professional when speaking with executives and decision-makers.

Hold a natural business conversation without reading everything from a script.

Strong written English is also required for
s, CRM notes, follow-ups, and business communication.

Applicants with limited spoken English or difficulty communicating naturally with North American clients will not be considered.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

Highly confident on the phone

A strong communicator

Persuasive without being pushy

Comfortable with cold calling

Comfortable talking to executives and business owners

Experienced in B2B sales

Experienced in outbound sales

Experienced in closing deals

Persistent and resilient

Goal-oriented

Organized

Self-motivated

Comfortable working independently

Able to handle rejection

Able to think on their feet

Professional and trustworthy

Comfortable working with targets and KPIs

You should be the type of person who can hear “No” ten times and still confidently make the eleventh call.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

B2B sales

SaaS sales

Professional services sales

Government contracting

Business development

Lead generation

Appointment setting

Cold calling

Outbound sales

High-ticket sales

Sales closing

Recruitment/staffing sales

IT services sales

Consulting sales

Administrative/business support services

Experience selling to companies, government contractors, procurement departments, or enterprise clients is a major advantage.



Performance Expectations

We are looking for someone who focuses on results, not simply hours worked.

Your performance will be evaluated based on metrics such as:



Number of quality outbound calls

Number of conversations with decision-makers

Qualified leads generated

Meetings booked

Follow-ups completed

Opportunities created

Sales pipeline generated

Deals closed

Revenue generated

Tools

CRM systems

Google Workspace

Google Sheets

Zoom


LinkedIn

VoIP/phone systems

Online research tools

Communication platforms

We want to build a long-term relationship with someone who can grow with the company, rather than hire someone who is simply looking for temporary work.

title: Insurance Verification Specialist

* Demographic errors

* Expired coverage
