title: Virtual Assistant- Real Estate Appraisal Firm
description:
JOB TITLE: Virtual Administrative Specialist – Daytime Shift (US Residential Appraisal Firm)



SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time (CST/CDT). Your own time zone does not matter, as long as you can reliably hold these hours every day.



LOCATION: 100% Remote



EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time



ABOUT US

MacDonnell Appraisals is a growing residential appraisal firm based in Missouri, serving 20+ counties across Northwest Missouri and Northeast Kansas. We specialize in private-side appraisal work: divorce, estate, litigation, tax appeals, luxury properties, and rural assignments. We use AI and automation to work efficiently, but what matters most to us is trust, our people, and our community. We are building toward becoming a regional valuation platform, and we need sharp, reliable people to help us get there.



THE ROLE

You are the daytime half of a two-person VA team, working under the direction of our Chief Operating Officer and coordinating with our overnight specialist for continuous, gapless coverage. You own the day shift. Live client calls and
s, scheduling, field inspector coordination, and keeping orders moving. At the end of your shift, you write a clear handoff for the overnight specialist: what's done, what's next, and any blockers. Tasks are either completed or escalated, never left hanging for the next shift.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Phone & client communication

- Answer inbound calls: general questions, private client inquiries, referrals, and call redirects

- Update clients on questions or concerns about their active appraisal

- Update clients when their inspection is scheduled and when it is completed

- Call homeowners directly to schedule inspections for refinance and private appraisal orders

- Text realtors to schedule inspections for purchase transactions

- Explain standard disclaimers to points of contact (45-minute inspection window, FHA attic/crawl space access, etc.)

- Request documents needed for each order (property updates, lease agreements, contracts)



Inbox and quote management

- Monitor and triage the 
 
 throughout the day

- Respond to quote and bid requests with clear pricing, timelines, and next steps



AMC coordination

- Update AMC portals every time a contact attempt is made for a point of contact, every attempt, every time

- Handle AMC profile updates as needed



Client onboarding and follow-through

- Send engagement letters and onboarding
s to every private client

- Confirm inspections are marked complete by the field inspector

- Confirm private clients have completed payment before files move forward



Order tracking and 

- Monitor the order tracker daily: enter new orders, log revisions, maintain CRM entries

- Review the overnight specialist's handoff each morning and execute priorities

- Write a clear end-of-shift handoff for the overnight specialist

- Escalate stuck or unclear tasks to leadership immediately, never leave them for the next shift



CRM and administrative records

- Enter new contacts from the business development team, call logs, and referral/nurture contacts

- Update CRM lead statuses (contacted, quoted, won, lost)

- Update E&O and license information for clients



Google Drive and file organization

- Organize and maintain appraisal work files in Google Drive



Marketing support (secondary)

- Assist with marketing administrative tasks as assigned

- Support social media content creation and board management with the content team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- 2+ years of VA or administrative assistant experience in a fast-paced environment

- Hands-on experience in the appraisal industry or real estate. This is required

- Proficient with 
, Asana, or a similar project management platform

- Expert with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sheets)

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills

- Strong written and verbal communication in English. Client-facing communication quality is non-negotiable

- Detail-oriented and committed to accuracy

- Ownership mentality: you escalate problems instead of letting them linger

- Available 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST reliably

- Comfortable working as part of a two-shift team with structured handoff protocols



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with appraisal software (URAR forms, UAD standards, GSE platforms)

- Knowledge of Zapier or other workflow automation tools

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- Comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for research, content, and productivity

- Real estate, lending, or property valuation background



WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY

- 100% remote, clear 9-to-5 schedule

- Room to grow into specialized roles as we scale: report writing, business development, operations leadership

- Training and support in appraisal operations

- Access to AI and automation tools already built into how we work

- Team culture built on clear communication, accountability, and ownership

- Be part of building a multi-state appraisal platform from the ground up



SALARY AND PAYMENT

$5.00–$6.00 per hour to start, based on experience. Room to grow after your first 90 days based on performance. Paid weekly for the first two months, then biweekly or monthly by agreement.



HOW TO APPLY

Please
 your resume, a short cover letter, and a brief description of your appraisal industry experience to 
 your cover letter, answer all four of the following questions:

1. What is your experience in appraisal operations?

2. Have you worked on a team with structured handoffs or shift changes? Describe a time you handled a task at risk of falling through the cracks.

3. Tell us about a time you handled a client escalation or a hard conversation. How did you approach it, and what was the outcome?

4. Why MacDonnell Appraisals?



COMMON QUESTIONS



Do I need to be in the US?

No. You work remotely from anywhere. You just need to be available 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM CST reliably.



Is appraisal experience required?

Yes. We need someone who understands how appraisal orders move through our system, what field teams need, and what clients expect. If you have worked at another appraisal firm, lending company, or title company, you are a strong candidate.



What about the handoff system?

You own daytime tasks. At the end of your shift, you document what is done and what is next for the overnight specialist. You escalate blockers instead of leaving them hanging. No task bounces back and forth.

title: OFFICE ADMIN MANAGER (VA / REMOTE WORK)
description:
About Us

We are Octo Pro Coatings (OPC), Southern California’s premier floor coating and surface care experts. We don’t just throw paint on a floor; we install high-performance, plant-based, sustainable coating systems that are tough enough to handle a dropped wrench, safe enough for kids and pets, and incredibly easy to clean. We are a cool, fun-loving team that doesn't take ourselves too seriously, but we take our craft, our clients, and our operations very seriously.



The Mission 

As our Remote Office Manager, your primary mission is to ensure the day-to-day operations run smoothly like a finely-tuned machine. You will coordinate personnel, resources, scheduling, and operational support, while leading our team of remote

administrative VAs and actively driving our sales calendar.



What You’ll Do

1. Administrative Leadership & Team Support

● Supervise our VA Team: Manage, mentor, and motivate our remote administrative staff. You will set daily priorities, handle scheduling, conduct check-ins, and deliver performance evaluations.

● Lead by Example: Provide backup support to the admin team when necessary and handle any escalated administrative matters with grace and professionalism.

2. Daily Operations & Logistics

● Inbox Management: Take full ownership of the 
 inbox, ensuring swift, professional, and on-brand responses.

● Keep the Calendar Booked (Sales Support): Monitor our sales pipeline and lead response times. Back up the sales team, follow up on warm leads, and ensure we are actively booking out our installation calendar.

● Crew & Tech Dispatch: Coordinate daily scheduling, managing roof access, keys, gate codes, permits, and site access requirements.

● Field Support: Ensure our technicians and subcontractors have everything they need to complete jobs successfully, handling any operational escalations that arise in the field.

3. Operational Analysis & Optimization

● Spot Gaps & Bottlenecks: Actively monitor daily operations to identify workflow inefficiencies. You will partner closely with our Integrator, delivering the hands-on data and analysis needed to help us sharpen and scale our systems.

4. HR Administration & Team Growth

● Hiring Pipeline: Help us scale by posting job advertisements, conducting initial interviews, and scheduling final interviews with leadership.

● Team Lifecycle: Manage the onboarding of new hires, execute smooth offboarding processes, and maintain up-to-date employee records.

● Policy & Accountability: Implement company policies and process technician write-ups or disciplinary documentation when necessary.

5. Inventory, Resources & Reporting

● Supply Management: Monitor inventory levels and ensure essential operational supplies and equipment are replenished.

● Operations Reporting: Compute production ratings, monitor overall operational performance, and maintain pristine records.

● Past-Due Follow-ups: Conduct follow-up calls on past-due accounts to keep our cash flow healthy.



Who You Are

● The Experienced Leader: You have 3+ years of experience managing a remote team of VAs, OR 5+ years of general experience as a team lead/manager (preferably in a service-based, home improvement, or contracting business).

● The Logistical Ninja: You know how to coordinate moving parts (subcontractors,

permits, schedules, and gate codes) without breaking a sweat.

● Sales-Minded Coordinator: You understand the urgency of lead management and love seeing a fully booked calendar.

● The Tech-Savvy Specialist: You are highly proficient with CRMs, scheduling software,
 managers, and communication tools (like Slack, G Suite, and dispatching software).

● Excellent Communicator: Your written and spoken English is top-tier. You know how to keep conversations with both internal crews and high-end clients professional, fun, and engaging.



Why You’ll Love Working With Us

● Awesome Company Culture: We work hard, we laugh a lot, and we celebrate wins

together. No stuffy corporate vibes here.

● 100% Remote: Work from anywhere, as long as you can reliably collaborate during

Southern California business hours.

● Premium Brand Pride: You are representing a business that uses premium,

eco-friendly, and plant-based products we can all feel good about.

● Growth Potential: We are growing fast, and we want you to grow with us.

 blasts, texts, and buyer communications for each new property

s within 10 minutes during work hours

* Are extremely organized and process-driven — you follow systems and improve them

We are a faith-driven team that moves with speed and precision, communicates obsessively, treats everyone with kindness, and outworks everyone around us. If that resonates — you’ll love it here.



Compensation



* Competitive base salary (paid weekly)

* Monthly team closing bonuses

* Weekly bonus opportunities

* Real growth potential — we are scaling and promote from within

title: DENTAL INSURANCE & TREATMENT FOLLOW-UP COORDINATOR
description:
We are a professional, growing two-location dental organization in Toronto, Canada. We are hiring a reliable, organized, phone-confident Remote Dental Insurance & Treatment Follow-Up Coordinator.



About the Role

This is a specialized long-term remote role for someone who follows systems carefully, documents accurately, communicates professionally in English, and enjoys helping patients move forward with recommended dental care.



Work Schedule (30 hours/week • EST Timezone)

• Monday to Friday: 9:00AM – 3:00PM EST, Toronto

*You must be consistently available during these exact hours.



Pay rate

• $4 - $7 CAD per hour (Initial 60-day pilot, with long-term opportunity for the right candidate)

*Please do not apply if your requested rate is above $7 CAD/hour.



Key Responsibilities

• Track and follow up on outstanding dental insurance predeterminations for two Canadian dental practices.

• Call Canadian insurance carriers to obtain status updates, identify missing requirements, and document all outcomes accurately.

• Maintain a centralized tracker so every case has a clear status, next action, due date, and owner.

• Follow up with patients who have outstanding recommended treatment.

• Use approved scripts to address straightforward administrative questions, discuss already-approved financial estimates, handle common non-clinical hesitations, and help patients book the appropriate next appointment.

• Make multiple follow-up attempts when appropriate and document every call, voi
, outcome, and next step.

• Support cases involving implants, implant restorations, crowns, bridges, periodontal therapy and scaling-unit eligibility, restorative treatment, orthodontic/aligner cases, dentures, surgery, and other proposed care.

• Escalate clinical, treatment, coding, documentation, and complex financial questions to the appropriate office team member.

• Send a concise daily activity report to the remote-assistant manager.



Systems

• Oryx Dental Practice Management

• Mango VoIP phone system with Toronto caller ID

• Secure Alexio-managed virtual machine



Training will be provided for our workflows, scripts, documentation standards, and escalation process.



Qualifications

• Excellent spoken and written English, with a warm, clear, professional phone manner.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, documentation, and follow-through

• Comfortable making outbound calls and remaining on hold with insurance carriers when needed.

• A quiet, private, professional work environment

• Reliable high-speed internet, a backup internet or power plan, and a professional headset

• Comfortable using a virtual machine, VoIP system, practice-management software, trackers, and structured scripts.

• Dental administration, dental insurance, medical insurance, healthcare administration, treatment coordination, recall/re-care, collections, patient outreach, or call-center experience is strongly preferred.

• Canadian dental insurance or predetermination experience is an advantage, but not required for a strong, trainable candidate.

• A high level of confidentiality, privacy awareness, and respect for patient information.

IMPORTANT: This is an administrative and patient-coordination role. You will NOT provide clinical advice, diagnose, recommend or change treatment, promise insurance payment, change fees, or make financial exceptions.



How to Apply

• Your UPDATED resume.

• A 60-second video introduction in English explaining why you are a good fit for this phone-based dental coordination role.

• Your requested hourly rate in CAD, within the $4–$7 CAD/hour range.

• Confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Toronto time.

• A short summary of your dental, healthcare, insurance, patient follow-up, treatment-coordination, call-centre, or administrative experience.

• Your internet speed, backup internet/power plan, and confirmation that you have a private workspace and professional headset.

• Two professional references.

• A short written response to this question:



A dental treatment predetermination has not received a response after the expected timeframe. What steps would you take, what would you document, and what would you escalate?



You may send the above-mentioned requirements to 



Only candidates who meet the pay range, Toronto-hours availability, English phone proficiency, privacy and technology requirements will be considered.

title: Social Media Manager + Short-Form Video Editor (Content, Posting, Direction) | Multiple Brands
description:
I'm the founder of several Australian businesses and I'm looking for a reliable, creative Social Media Manager who can own the entire content pipeline across my brands



I record raw videos and dump them into a shared Google Drive. You take it from there: edit them into polished short-form content, write captions and hashtags, schedule and post across accounts, and most importantly, tell me what to record next. You'll build content calendars per brand and send me clear briefs ("this week film these 3 videos, here are the hooks and talking points"). I want a partner who drives the content strategy, not just an editor waiting for instructions.



Brands you'll manage:



1. BBS Health (health/e-commerce) - primary focus

2. My personal founder brand on Instagram (business, AI, entrepreneurship content)

3. Northstar Digital (digital agency) - meta and google ad digital marketing. 

4. Possibly Lighthaus - SaaS

5. Possibly one more brand later as we grow



Your responsibilities:



• Edit raw talking-head and b-roll footage into engaging Reels/Shorts/TikToks (captions, cuts, hooks, music, motion graphics)

• Manage the content calendar for each brand

• Post and schedule content (primarily Instagram, plus TikTok/LinkedIn/YouTube Shorts where relevant)

• Give me weekly video direction: topics, hooks, scripts/outlines for each brand

• Write captions and hashtag sets in a natural, native-English style

• Track basic performance (views, engagement) and adjust strategy based on what works

• Keep the Drive organized (raw footage in, finished assets out)



Requirements:



• Proven short-form editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar) - portfolio required

• Experience managing and growing Instagram accounts (show me examples)

• Strong written English for captions and briefs

• Organized, self-directed, and proactive - you suggest ideas, you don't wait to be told

• Understands hooks, retention editing, and current short-form trends

• Comfortable working with Google Drive and a scheduling tool (e.g. Later, Metricool, Buffer)

• Available with some overlap with Sydney, Australia hours (AEST)



Nice to have:



• Basic graphic design (Canva) for carousels and thumbnails

• Experience with founder/personal brands or agency content

• Understanding of health/wellness or B2B content

title: Software Developer
description:
We are looking for a software developer who has embraced the major shift happening in software development over the last 1–2 years.



We are not specifically looking for the developer with the most years of traditional programming experience. We are looking for someone who has learned how to use modern AI development tools to build good software faster and more effectively.  We have incorpoirated these systems fully into our process, and we with that we need team members that also know what Codex, Claude or Cursor are and how to use them



If your development workflow still looks basically the same as it did three years ago, this probably isn't the right role.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Uses AI coding tools as a core part of their everyday development workflow

* Has hands-on experience with tools such as **OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot**, or similar

* Knows how to give AI enough context to work effectively within a larger codebase

* Can use AI to investigate existing systems, build features, refactor code, debug issues and write tests

* Understands when to trust AI-generated code—and when not to

* Can move quickly from an idea or specification to working software

* Is comfortable working across different technologies rather than being locked into one framework

* Understands Git, APIs, databases, frontend/backend development and normal software engineering fundamentals

* Is interested in experimenting with agents, MCP, automation and emerging AI development workflows



What We Don't Care About



You don't need 10+ years of experience.



You don't need to have spent your entire career specializing in one framework.



Someone with 2–5 years of development experience who has become extremely effective with AI-assisted development may be much more interesting to us than someone with 15 years of experience who hasn't adapted their workflow.



The Work



You'll work on real client software projects and internal products, including:



* Web applications

* Business operations software

* APIs and integrations

* Internal tools

* AI-enabled applications and workflows

* Existing systems that need to be understood, improved or rebuilt



Our projects vary, so being able to quickly understand an unfamiliar codebase or technology is important.



The Person We're Looking For



You are probably a good fit if you've found yourself thinking:



**“AI has completely changed the way I develop software.”**



You experiment with new tools as they appear. You've figured out workflows that allow you to accomplish significantly more than you could through traditional development alone.



## When Applying



Please don't send us a generic cover letter.



Instead, tell us:



What AI development tools do you currently use?  Walk us through your normal AI-assisted development workflow, send a recorded Loom or video please

title: Reddit posting and content creation
description:
Our compensation structure is performance-based, with performance-based pay calculated based on the number of valid posts/comments and the quality of engagement. Our product page link is: 
. You need to understand NBA 2K27 and engage deeply with the Reddit community to create content that resonates with players. Naturally embed our product link in your posts and comments. Remember, Reddit strictly controls all marketing activities; you need to create genuinely meaningful NBA 2K27 game content for players.



The logic behind this change is simple: we want your earnings to directly reflect the value of your content—the more high-quality content you post and the better the engagement, the higher your earnings. Conversely, deleted or unengaged content will not be compensated. We believe this approach is fairer to both parties.



The standards are as follows:

Delivery Method | Unit Price | Settlement Terms

Complete Post (including link) | $3.00/post | Not deleted within 48 hours and receives ≥ 5 likes

Detailed Comment (including link) | $1.20/comment | Not deleted within 48 hours and receives ≥ 3 likes

Regular Comment (including MMOEXP logo or text) | $0.60/comment | Not deleted within 48 hours



Additional Quality Bonuses:



 Posts receiving 20 or more likes: Additional $2



 Posts receiving 50 or more likes: Additional $4



 Posts pinned or recommended by moderators: Additional $5



Situations that may result in non-payment:



 Posts/comments deleted by moderators → No payment



 Duplicate posts with the same content across multiple subforums → Only counted once



 Pure links with no substantive content → No payment



 Accounts receiving warnings for policy violations → 50% of all earnings for the week will be deducted.



• Account Banned → All earnings this week will be forfeited, and the partnership will be terminated.



If you accept this compensation plan, please reply to confirm. Upon confirmation, I will provide account details and product information.



Please adhere to the following three rules during the hearing:



1. Submit Daily Reports via Google Forms



Please create a form containing the following and share it with me:

Date

Type

Subforum Link

Likes

Status (Active/Deleted)



Update daily – I will check the links there.



2. First Two Days: Only 2-3 posts are allowed per day.



Post cautiously. Focus on commenting and getting to know the community. We will evaluate your posting after the second day and d
 if you can post more.



3. Quality over Quantity.



One high-quality, engaging post is better than ten mediocre ones. Deleted posts are worthless. Take the time to write valuable content.



Note that this is not an employment model; you can perform this task at any time for payment. If you agree, we will discuss in detail how to post and what content to post.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor / Content VA – TikTok, Reels & YouTube
description:
We are looking for a reliable, responsive, and highly coachable Video Editor / Content VA to work directly with a content creator and help turn raw footage into high-quality short-form content.



The primary responsibility is simple:



Take raw footage → edit it → deliver finished videos on time.



The goal is to consistently produce up to 10 short-form videos per day for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Edit up to 10 short-form videos per day from provided raw footage

* Create content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Edit videos in CapCut or similar editing software

* Add captions, text, cuts, zooms, transitions, music, sound effects, B-roll, and other elements when appropriate

* Learn and replicate the creator’s existing editing style

* Follow detailed examples and feedback to make the editing style consistent across videos

* Gradually learn and incorporate new editing styles as the creator’s content evolves

* Organize raw footage and completed videos using Google Drive

* Track content and assignments using Google Sheets

* Make revisions quickly when requested

* Communicate clearly and consistently throughout the day

* Meet deadlines without needing to be constantly reminded



THIS ROLE IS ABOUT MORE THAN EDITING



We can teach you the exact editing style we want.



You do not need to already know exactly how we want every video edited.



What matters most to us is your ability to learn quickly, follow instructions, pay attention to detail, and consistently improve.



We will provide examples of the style we like and teach you our editing process. As you become comfortable with the system, you’ll be expected to take more ownership and eventually be able to make good editing decisions without needing instructions for every video.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



1. Reliability – If you say something will be done, it needs to be done.



2. Responsiveness – We need someone who communicates quickly and doesn’t disappear when something needs to be changed.



3. Ability to learn – We’re willing to teach the right person our style and systems.



4. Speed + quality – We are producing a high volume of content, so you need to become efficient without letting quality fall apart.



5. Attention to detail – Small mistakes in captions, cuts, formatting, or instructions matter.



REQUIREMENTS



* Fluent written and spoken English

* Previous experience with CapCut or another video editing platform preferred

* Experience editing TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar content preferred

* Comfortable working with Google Drive and Google Sheets

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Able to work independently after training

* Able to handle multiple videos and deadlines at the same time

* Willing to receive feedback and make changes quickly

* Must be highly responsive and communicative



WORK ARRANGEMENT



This is a full-time position with flexible working hours.



We care more about getting the work completed correctly and on time than requiring you to sit at a computer for exactly 8 hours every day.



You will have daily production targets and deadlines. As long as the work is completed to the expected standard and you remain responsive when communication is needed, you will have flexibility in how you structure your workday.



There will be an agreed period of availability for communication and feedback.



COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE BONUSES



Starting base salary: $400–$500 USD/month, depending on experience and editing ability.



There is also an opportunity to earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on the total performance of the content you help produce.



For example:



* 1,000,000+ total monthly views: additional $50 bonus

* 2,000,000+ total monthly views: additional $100 bonus

* 5,000,000+ total monthly views: additional $200 bonus



As the content operation grows, there will be opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility.



We want the person in this role to benefit when the content performs well.



TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous video editing experience

3. 2–3 examples of videos you have edited

4. What editing software you use

5. Your internet connection speed

6. Your computer/laptop specifications

7. Your expected monthly salary

8. Your availability



Please start your application with the word “CONTENT” so we know you read the entire job posting.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a small editing test using raw footage so we can evaluate your ability to learn and follow a specific editing style.

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

- Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

- Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

- The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

- The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

- Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

- Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

- Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

- An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

- Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

- Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

- Remote, international team

- Contractor position, paid biweekly

- Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

- Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.



Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor



You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.



Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.



Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: Virtual Assistant (Music Industry - Social Media)
description:
Producer Labs is a music marketing agency in Los Angeles.



We're hiring a Campaign Coordinator to support two of our campaign managers. When a label sends over a song and a budget, you're the person who turns that into creators booked, drafts collected, and posts live on schedule.



This is a graveyard shift. You must be online and reachable 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Pacific Time, which is about 1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time. Please only apply if you can commit to those hours long-term.



How the business works: a brand or label comes to us with a budget and a song. That budget gets allocated to creators on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube who post with the track. We don't manage creators — we build relationships and deploy them on campaigns. You'll be in the middle of that, talking to creators every day.



We're an early, fast-moving team, so the scope of this role will shift as we grow. It suits someone who wants more on their plate over time, takes on new problems without waiting for perfect instructions, and treats being handed more responsibility as the point, not the burden.



What you'll do



Build and vet creator lists for active campaigns, and help put together the proposal that goes back to the client

Run creator outreach and negotiation over DM and
 — pitch, agree a rate, confirm the booking

Chase drafts and posts: get ETAs, check content against the brief, follow up until it's live

Swap out creators who go quiet or fall through, and refill the slot before the deadline moves

Keep 15–20 live campaigns current in Airtable so anyone can see where each one stands

Raise stuck campaigns early with what you've already tried and what you need



Must-haves



2+ years in campaign support, coordination, or a VA role with real outreach volume

Strong written English — you'll be pitching creators and sitting in client chats

Comfortable on video calls, and comfortable being the person who raises a problem

Organized across many campaigns at once without dropping follow-ups

Can commit to the graveyard shift long-term

Reliable power and internet, with a backup plan for outages



Nice-to-haves



Music marketing, influencer marketing, or creator-economy experience

Deck-building in Gamma, Canva, or Google Slides

Airtable, 
, Slack



To apply, send one outreach message you've actually sent to a creator or partner, and tell us what happened next. Shortlisted applicants will get a short Google Form before a 20-minute video interview.

title: MedVA - Patient Recall Specialist – Pain Management / Primary Care
description:
NOW HIRING: Patient Recall Specialist – Pain Management / Primary Care (Remote | Full-Time)



We are looking for a confident and persuasive Patient Recall Specialist to support a Pain Management / Primary Care practice. The primary focus of this role is reaching out to patients who have missed appointments and successfully getting them back on the schedule.



Position Details



• Employment Type: Full-Time

• Rate: $5–$6/hour, based on experience

• Paid U.S. Holidays



Clinic Details



• Specialty: Pain Management / Primary Care

• EHR/EMR: Tebra

• Phone System: Weave



Key Responsibilities



• Work through patient recall and missed-appointment lists

• Make outbound calls to patients who missed or did not complete scheduled appointments

• Successfully book and reschedule appointments

• Follow up consistently with patients who have not yet rebooked

• Clearly explain the importance of returning for follow-up care

• Address patient hesitation or objections professionally

• Maintain a strong and consistent follow-up process



Non-Negotiable Requirements



• Strong phone and communication skills

• Confident and persuasive when speaking with patients

• Able to speak with conviction and clearly justify why patients should schedule their appointments

• Comfortable handling objections and encouraging hesitant patients to book

• Strong outbound calling and follow-up skills

• Professional, confident, and engaging phone presence

• Previous healthcare front desk, patient scheduling, recall, or appointment-setting experience is highly preferred

title: Procurement Specialist (experience with US and Asian suppliers required)
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a U.S.-based manufacturer and eCommerce company specializing in high-performance adhesives and industrial products. We serve customers through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B distribution channels across multiple global markets.



We are looking for a Procurement Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable commercial terms, solving supply chain challenges, and continuously improving procurement operations. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

Recommend sourcing strategies that improve overall profitability.



Procurement Operations

Maintain accurate supplier records and procurement databases.

Support purchase order creation and supplier follow-ups.

Keep supplier pricing, lead times, MOQs, and procurement data up to date.

Organize procurement documentation and sourcing records.

Ensure procurement information is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare procurement reports and sourcing updates.

Maintain procurement dashboards and tracking tools.

Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and documentation.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

Proactively identify supply risks and recommend mitigation strategies.





Qualifications



Required

Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain.

Hands-on experience working with both U.S. and Asian suppliers (China, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or other APAC countries).

Proven experience sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating with international suppliers.

Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

Excellent analytical and cost analysis abilities.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.



Preferred

Experience working with contract manufacturers or OEM/ODM suppliers.

Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, or eCommerce businesses.

Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or procurement management systems.

Experience analyzing supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs.





What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

Takes ownership and follows through without constant supervision.

Builds strong supplier relationships while negotiating effectively.

Thinks strategically and solves problems proactively.

Communicates clearly and escalates risks early.

Makes data-driven decisions rather than assumptions.

Continuously looks for opportunities to improve procurement processes.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Can comfortably work with suppliers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google,
, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify,
, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee
 and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google,
, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads,
 marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.



Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.

title: Video Editor / Content Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
About the Role

Starbond is looking for a creative and highly skilled Video Editor who can transform technical woodworking content into engaging, high-performing videos across YouTube, social media, and our Shopify Masterclass platform.

This role goes beyond editing videos, you'll help maximize the reach and impact of our educational content by improving click-through rates, optimizing titles and thumbnails, and repurposing long-form tutorials into engaging short-form content.



Key Responsibilities:



Video Production & Editing

Collaborate with the content creation and marketing teams to understand creative direction, campaign objectives, and storytelling goals.

Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos while maintaining Starbond's brand standards.

Perform professional post-production including:

Color correction

Audio enhancement

Motion graphics

Seamless transitions

Visual effects where appropriate

Design compelling graphics, titles, lower thirds, and animations.

Create high-converting video thumbnails for YouTube and social media.

Organize and maintain video assets and project files for efficient collaboration.

Stay current with the latest editing trends, software, and best practices.



Content Marketing & YouTube Optimization

Support the growth of Starbond's educational content ecosystem by helping optimize both YouTube performance and our Shopify Masterclass experience.



YouTube Masterclass

Review Starbond's library of paid creator-partner tutorial videos.

Identify valuable tutorials suitable for publishing on the Starbond Masterclass landing page.

Optimize video titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and supporting copy to improve click-through rates.

Balance YouTube-friendly titles with customer-friendly titles suitable for the Shopify Masterclass website.

Help drive engagement by increasing views, watch time, and discoverability.



Shopify Masterclass Initiative:

Our YouTube videos are embedded into the Starbond Shopify Masterclass website.

Customers access these tutorials by scanning QR codes included with our Superglue Pro Kit packaging and user guides.



Your work will help:

Increase Masterclass page engagement

Increase YouTube video views

Improve customer education

Support YouTube algorithm performance through higher engagement

Short-Form Content Creation

Repurpose long-form woodworking tutorials into engaging short-form content for:

YouTube Shorts

Instagram Reels

TikTok

 Reels

Other emerging social platforms

You'll identify the most valuable educational moments and transform them into content that attracts new audiences while maintaining Starbond's educational and professional brand.



Required Skills :

Video Editing

Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software

Motion graphics and animation

Color grading and correction

Audio editing and mixing

Storytelling through video

Strong visual design skills

Excellent attention to detail

Content Marketing (Bonus)



Experience with:

YouTube SEO

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Click-through rate (CTR) optimization

Copywriting for titles and thumbnails

Thumbnail strategy

YouTube analytics

Content repurposing

Audience engagement strategies



Qualifications:

Minimum 4 years of professional Video Editing experience

Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality video editing work

Experience creating content for YouTube and social media

Experience editing educational or tutorial content is highly preferred

Amazon listing images, infographics, and Amazon A+ Content experience is a strong advantage (please provide a separate portfolio if applicable)

Excellent organizational and project management skills

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Strong communication skills

Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback

Passion for creating engaging educational content

Interest in woodworking, DIY, or maker communities is a plus



Application Requirements:

Resume/CV (applications without a resume will not be considered)

Portfolio demonstrating video editing work

Portfolio link with viewing permissions enabled

Separate portfolio showcasing Amazon images, infographics, and Amazon A+ Content (if applicable)

Remote

Schedule:

title: AI E-commerce Video Editor for AliExpress Products
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Video Editor who can independently create high-converting video ads for AliExpress products.



This is not a basic video editing position where we provide the script, footage, and complete concept.



You will often receive only an AliExpress product link. From there, you should be able to research the product, understand the customer, find strong selling angles and hooks, source or generate the necessary content, and create the complete video ad from beginning to end.



What You Will Do



-Research AliExpress products, competitors, customer pain points, benefits, reviews, and existing ads



-Find strong hooks, selling angles, emotional triggers, and video concepts



-Write or improve scripts for short-form ecommerce ads



-Find existing product footage, UGC, demonstrations, reviews, competitor content, and other useful content online



-Use AI tools to generate missing footage when suitable existing content cannot be found



-Create realistic AI product demonstrations, lifestyle scenes, UGC-style content, actors, voiceovers, and other visuals



-Make sure AI-generated footage accurately represents the real product



-Edit complete ads with strong hooks, pacing, captions, pattern interrupts, sound effects, music, voiceovers, product demonstrations, and CTAs



-Create multiple hooks, intros, angles, and variations for the same product



-Create ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms



What We Are Looking For



-Strong experience creating ecommerce or dropshipping video ads



-Excellent video editing skills



-Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and customer psychology



-Experience with modern AI video and image generation tools



-Ability to create realistic AI footage based on AliExpress product images and videos



-Ability to independently research products, competitors, customers, and existing ads



-Strong understanding of hooks, angles, storytelling, retention, and CTAs



-Ability to turn an AliExpress product link into a complete professional video ad without needing detailed instructions



AI Experience



You should be comfortable using AI for video generation, image generation, AI UGC, realistic actors, product visualization, voiceovers, image-to-video generation, lip syncing, scene creation, and improving existing product footage.



The specific tools you use are less important than the quality and realism of the final result.



When Applying



1-Send examples of ecommerce video ads you personally created



2-Send examples where you received only a product or product link and created the complete ad yourself



3-Send your best examples of AI-generated product footage, AI UGC, or AI video ads



4-For your examples, explain exactly what you were responsible for: research, angles, hooks, scripts, footage sourcing, AI generation, editing, voiceovers, captions, and CTAs



5-Tell us which AI and video editing tools you currently use



6-Explain your complete process if we give you only an AliExpress product link



7-How long does it normally take you to create one complete 20–45 second video ad from beginning to end, including research, scripting, sourcing or generating footage, and editing?



8-How many complete video ads can you realistically create per working day?

title: COLD CALLING CAMPAIGN IN THE BUSIEST US MARKET
description:
We are looking for people with cold calling experience in the roofing or real estate industry.



What you'll be doing:

Calling Texas homeowners about storm damage, finding interested and qualified people, and booking appointments. 



The script is simple, and we are looking for people who just have the energy to push it forward and set appointments.

$3-$5 USD/hour based on your performance 

+$25 for every sale closed



Dialers that turn out to be SHARKS have the opportunity to make significantly more than that - both hourly and bonus amounts going up if you can prove yourself.

Mon–Fri, 11am–8pm CST. 8 hours of work + 1 hour unpaid break whenever you want to take it.

40 hours a week required, and optional Saturdays available for extra.

You freeze when a homeowner says "not interested"

You've never been on a US based roofing cold calling campaign.

You are happy to just make an hourly wage and not stack up sales for BIG bonuses. 



Ready to prove it?

DM us with a 30-second voice or video message. Tell us who you are, what campaigns you've worked, and why you're the one we should call back.

We don't drag out the process. If you've got it, you'll know fast.

title: Google Ads PPC Manager & Account Manager (A-Player)
description:
Remote · Full-Time · up to 40 hours per week



Mario Moosbauer · Munich, Germany



About Us

Mario Moosbauer is the founder and CEO of Natureich, an Amazon FBA brand selling wooden math and learning toys worldwide, and the owner of a growing E-commerce agency that helps consumer brands grow through paid advertising, video content, conversion-focused landing pages, and marketplace optimization.

You will work directly with Mario and take ownership of Google Ads accounts for our agency clients and selected campaigns across our own businesses.



The Opportunity: Real Ownership, Direct Mentorship

This is not a junior support role. From day one, you manage Google Ads accounts with real budgets and real responsibility. You analyze performance, fix tracking problems, build campaign structures, and communicate clearly with clients and the CEO.

You get direct, hands-on mentorship from the CEO — regular calls, honest feedback, and a clear path to more responsibility as you prove yourself.

Mandatory Requirement: Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads and improving measurable business results with real budgets.



The Mission

Your mission is to become our Google Ads performance and account expert.

You will manage Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns for multiple E-commerce and lead-generation accounts. You audit existing accounts, build new campaigns, improve conversion tracking, reduce wasted spend, and scale profitable campaigns without losing control of ROAS or CPA.

You move fast. You can run several accounts and projects at the same time without dropping anything. You want more responsibility over time — and you will get it.



Measurable Outcomes (What you must achieve)

1. Client Ads Performance: Bring each new client account to its agreed ROAS or CPA/CPL target within 60 days of taking it over. Keep at least 90% of managed accounts within target every month after that.

2. Profitable Growth: Increase qualified leads or conversion value by at least 15% within 6 months on scalable accounts, while maintaining the agreed profitability target.

3. Tracking Accuracy: Audit every new account within 14 days. Ensure all critical conversions are tracked correctly through Google Ads, GA4, and GTM, with no duplicate or missing primary conversion actions.

4. Client Retention: Through reliable campaign management and clear communication, help keep client churn below 10% per year on the accounts you manage.

5. Speed & Capacity: Manage multiple accounts and priorities without missing deadlines. Respond to urgent requests within 24 hours and deliver clear weekly performance updates on time.



Role-Specific Competencies (Hard Skills)

Non-negotiable:

6. Google Ads Mastery: 2+ years hands-on managing Google Ads with real budgets. Strong Search experience is required; Shopping and Performance Max experience is strongly preferred.

7. Performance Optimization: You understand ROAS, CPA, CPL, CAC, conversion rate, impression share, search terms, match types, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.

8. Conversion Tracking: Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. You can diagnose broken, missing, or duplicate conversion tracking.

9. Account Management: Experience managing multiple Google Ads accounts or clients at the same time, with clear reporting and proactive communication.

10. AI-Savvy: You use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude every day to analyze faster, improve workflows, and communicate clearly.

11. Communication: Excellent written and spoken English for direct communication with the CEO and clients. Good camera and reliable internet connection.



Nice to have:

12. Google Shopping and Merchant Center feed optimization

13. YouTube Ads, Display, Demand Gen, or Microsoft Ads experience

14. Looker Studio reporting and dashboard experience

15. Shopify, WooCommerce, landing-page, or CRO experience

16. Experience with E-commerce brands and lead-generation businesses

17. German language basics



Cultural Competencies (Who you are)

18. A-Player Mentality: You do not wait to be told what to do; you proactively spot problems and solve them.

19. Hungry for Responsibility: You want to take ownership, prove yourself, and grow into bigger responsibility over time.

20. Integrity & Honesty: You report bad performance or tracking issues early and arrive with a plan to fix them.

21. Reliability & High Performance: You consistently deliver high-quality work and never miss a deadline.

22. Obsession with Optimization: You improve campaigns, tracking, reporting, or processes every week.

23. Detail-Oriented: You care about small tracking errors and search-term waste as much as the bigger growth strategy.



What This Is Not

24. A Meta-Ads-only role

25. A set-it-and-forget-it campaign-management job

26. A role for someone who only knows Google Ads theory or certifications

27. A place for people who need constant direction

28. A fit for anyone who treats “good enough” as done



Position Details

Schedule: Up to 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri), flexible

Location: 100% Remote

Contract: Freelance

Start: As soon as possible



To Apply

Please send your resume and a brief cover letter to Mario Moosbauer at 
 In your cover letter, describe one specific Google Ads account or campaign you managed. State the starting monthly ad spend and ROAS or CPA/CPL, what you changed, the result you achieved, and the timeframe. Please use real numbers.

We look forward to hearing from you!



Mario Moosbauer

CEO, Natureich

Ainmillerstraße 50 · 80801 München · Germany

title: Higgsfield, Nanabanna Pro and HeyGen Experet
description:
A few of the core principles of Reality Transurfing are:



Reduce importance.

Zeland argues that when you desperately need something to happen, you create "excess potential." In his system, excessive attachment actually creates resistance.

Idea: Want the outcome, move toward it, but don't make your happiness depend on it.

Don't fight pendulums.

A "pendulum" is a collective structure that feeds on people's attention and emotional energy—politics, arguments, social expectations, trends, organizations, etc. Fighting something can actually give it more of your attention.

Idea: Instead of fighting what you don't want, withdraw your attention and move toward what you do want.

Choose rather than desire.

There's a major distinction between wanting a reality and internally treating it as something you've chosen. Zeland emphasizes intention over wishing.

Simplified: Don't think, "I desperately hope I become this person." Operate from "This is where I'm going."

Your "slide" influences your reality.

A slide is essentially the internal picture you repeatedly carry of yourself and your life. Zeland teaches deliberately creating a positive slide depicting the reality you want and experiencing it internally rather than merely watching it like a movie.

Stop forcing the path.

Transurfing distinguishes inner intention—trying to force circumstances through your own effort—from outer intention, where circumstances seemingly begin aligning with your chosen direction.

Idea: Keep taking action, but don't insist that your goal must happen through one particular route.

The alternatives flow.

Instead of constantly trying to control everything, Zeland teaches paying attention to what reality is presenting and taking the path that opens naturally rather than unnecessarily battling circumstances.



The overarching Transurfing idea is basically:



Stop fighting reality to get what you want. Choose the reality you want, align yourself with it, reduce your attachment to the outcome, and move in its direction.



One caveat: concepts such as the "alternatives space" and "outer intention" are part of Zeland's metaphysical framework, not established scientific principles.



Interestingly, #3 and #4 are the closest parallels to identity programming: instead of continually viewing the desired version of yourself as someone you're trying to become, you repeatedly operate from the internal representation of "this is who I am."



Yesterday 9:13 AM

Can the amount of calories that you burn be increased simply by breathing differently? Because I'm thinking about how if you control your breathing, you can keep your heart rate at a certain pace, but if you change your breathing, you could inevitably heighten the heart rate. So does that mean the way you breathe can burn more calories? And if so, could you burn a significant amount of calories simply by controlling your breathing or breathing a certain way to get your heart rate up without working out?



Yes, changing your breathing can change your energy expenditure, but there's an important catch: raising your heart rate through breathing does not automatically mean you're burning a meaningful number of additional calories.



Your intuition has part of the mechanism right, but heart rate and calorie expenditure aren't causally interchangeable.



What happens when you deliberately breathe harder?



Breathing itself requires muscular work. Your diaphragm, intercostal muscles, and accessory respiratory muscles consume energy. If you intentionally breathe faster or deeper, those muscles work harder, so calorie expenditure rises somewhat.



Certain breathing patterns can also activate your sympathetic nervous system and increase heart rate.



But here's the key distinction:



High heart rate ≠ necessarily high calorie burn.



During exercise, your heart rate rises primarily because your working muscles suddenly need much more oxygen and fuel. Your heart is responding to the body's increased metabolic demand.



If you intentionally breathe rapidly while sitting still, you can increase your heart rate without creating anything close to the metabolic demand of running, cycling, etc.



Think:



Exercise:

Muscles work → ATP demand skyrockets → oxygen demand increases → heart pumps faster → substantial calories expended.



Deliberate rapid breathing:

Breathing changes → nervous-system/CO₂ changes → heart rate may increase → skeletal-muscle energy demand remains relatively low → relatively little additional calorie expenditure.



So if you sat on the couch and deliberately manipulated your breathing until your heart rate reached, say, 120 bpm, that would not mean you're burning the same calories as when your heart reaches 120 bpm from walking uphill.



Could you theoretically burn significant calories through breathing alone?



Under normal circumstances, not enough to make it a useful fat-loss strategy.



Your respiratory muscles already account for some energy expenditure, and making breathing substantially harder can increase their metabolic cost. But to make breathing itself consume large amounts of energy, you'd essentially have to make the respiratory muscles perform strenuous work—which isn't a practical substitute for exercise.



There's another interesting distinction: fat does literally leave your body largely through your lungs. When triglycerides are metabolized, much of their mass eventually leaves as carbon dioxide you exhale, with the remainder largely becoming water.



But that does not mean:



"Exhale more → lose more fat."



You have to oxidize the stored fuel first. Breathing is largely the exit route for the carbon; simply moving more air doesn't force your body to burn large quantities of fat.



Here's the interesting implication of your idea



If your objective were to burn calories without conventional exercise, manipulating breathing isn't the lever I'd choose.



Increasing muscular activity is dramatically more effective. Even low-intensity movement—walking, standing more, pacing, household activity, taking stairs, fidgeting—raises energy expenditure because you're making large skeletal muscles repeatedly consume ATP.



So your original hypothesis is directionally correct:



Different breathing → potentially higher heart rate + slightly greater energy expenditure.



But this part doesn't follow:



Higher heart rate from breathing → exercise-level calorie expenditure.



Heart rate is a useful proxy for energy expenditure during certain kinds of exercise; it isn't the thing actually causing most of those calories to be burned.



And deliberately hyperventilating to drive your heart rate up isn't a good strategy—it can lower CO₂ enough to cause dizziness, tingling, lightheadedness, or fainting.

Other times, you'll get a rough idea, a voice note, or a half-formed concept and need to help turn it into something useful, organized, and polished. That's a big part of the job.



This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after the first few months if it's a strong mutual fit. Ideally, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



One other thing, you don't need to come from finance, although you should be interested in learning it. This is an industry where expertise matters, and the better you understand our business, our advisors, and our clients, the better you'll become at this role. We'll help you learn, but you should genuinely want to.



What You'll Do:

Project Support:

- Organize projects, priorities, meetings, and follow-ups

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, and developers

- Help make sure things don't quietly fall through the cracks



Creative & Communication:

- Create beautifully designed presentations, one-pagers, training materials, internal communications, and visual assets

- Turn rough notes or concepts into polished outputs

- Help maintain consistency across our brand and internal tools

- Look at something we've created and tell us, honestly, "this could be better"



Systems & Operations:

- Maintain daily spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and project pipelines

- Test new internal tools and identify improvements

- Find ways to simplify or automate repetitive work



AI & Technology:

- Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, and Google Workspace to research, create, and improve work

- Experiment with new tools and figure things out quickly

- Help us find smarter ways to work as new technology becomes available



You don't need to know every tool already. Being resourceful and learning quickly matters much more.



Who We're Looking For:

You'll probably thrive here if you:

- Have excellent written English

- Are highly organized and dependable

- Have strong visual/design taste (this is more important than I'm probably letting on in this posting)

- Can work independently without needing constant direction

- Learn new tools quickly

- Can manage multiple projects without losing the details

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Naturally look for better ways to do things

- Have high integrity and are comfortable being transparent (this is also more important than I’m probably letting on in this posting)



Above everything else, we're looking for judgment, initiative, and ownership. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, ask good questions, and care about getting to the right outcome.



Why Work With Us?

- Direct exposure to company leadership and decision-making

- Meaningful projects alongside the more traditional VA work

- Creative freedom; good ideas are genuinely encouraged

- Opportunity to learn AI, technology, operations, and business

- Increasing responsibility as your capabilities grow

- A real pathway from part-time into a full-time role

- A stable company with ambitious long-term growth plans

- A predominantly Filipino team and client community (99% of the company and clients come from a Filipino background)

- The chance to actually see your work shape how a company operates (for real)



How to Apply:

If you've made it this far, include the word "builder" somewhere in the first sentence of your application so we know you actually read the posting.



Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Why this role caught your attention

3. Your answer to this question: What does the best boss you've ever worked with do that brings out your best work? And what does a manager do that makes it harder for you to perform?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone smart, creative, trustworthy, and hungry to become exceptionally good at what they do. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
