title: Real Estate Lead Qualifier (Warm Leads | EST Shift)
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a disciplined and high-performing Lead Qualifier to manage our warm lead database. This is a targeted role focused on re-engaging property owners who have previously shown interest in selling.



This position requires a "prospecting athlete"—someone who can maintain high energy across a split-shift schedule to reach homeowners at peak response times. You will vet leads for motivation and property details before passing them to our senior acquisitions team.



The Schedule & Performance Standards

This role is strictly tied to Eastern Standard Time (EST). To maximize contact rates, you will work one or two of the following windows:



Morning: 8 AM – 10 AM EST



Mid-day: 12 PM – 2 PM EST



Evening: 5 PM – 8 PM EST



Success is measured by data. We are a KPI-driven (Key Performance Indicator) company. You will be expected to:



Maintain a consistent daily call volume (Expected: 250 dials per day).



Meet weekly targets for qualified leads and warm transfers.



Log all activity with 100?curacy in our CRM.



Required Qualifications

Real Estate Expertise: 1–2 years of experience in Real Estate cold calling or lead management is required.



Objection Mastery: You must be able to handle "not interested" or price objections with grace, curiosity, and persistence.



EST Availability: You must be fully available and alert during the specific split-shift hours listed above.



Technical Specs: Noise-canceling headset, stable high-speed internet, and a backup power solution.



Key Responsibilities

Call "Old Warm" leads to re-verify selling intent.



Qualify leads based on the 3 Pillars: Interest in selling, Price and Motivation.



Perform seamless warm transfers to the acquisitions team.



Overcome gatekeepers and stalls to reach the decision-maker.



Mandatory Paid Training



***Include a voice recording in your submission***

title: Real Estate Closer | Convert Warm Leads into Contracts
description:
Hourly + Commission-Based Real Estate Closer | Convert Warm Leads into Contracts

Description:

We’re seeking a sharp, commission-based Real Estate Closer to join our growing acquisitions team. This is not a cold calling role—you’ll be working exclusively with warm and hot leads already in our pipeline. Your only focus is turning motivated seller conversations into signed wholesale contracts.

We close 4+ deals per month and are scaling. You’ll be walking into a proven system, not trying to build one from scratch. Our team handles lead generation, follow-up, and transaction coordination. We just need a closer who can lock in the deals.

________________________________________

About Us:

We are an experienced real estate investment company working primarily in North Carolina. We specialize in off-market wholesale deals, creative financing, and helping sellers find quick, stress-free solutions. With a reliable marketing engine and a team handling systems, follow-up, and transaction coordination, you’ll be backed by solid infrastructure that allows you to focus on closing.

We consistently provide a steady flow of qualified leads ready for conversion and are committed to building long-term partnerships with our team.

________________________________________

Your Role:

• Speak with warm/hot seller leads by phone

• Build rapport, uncover motivation, and negotiate win-win offers

• Confidently guide the conversation toward a signed contract

• Use our CRM (GHL-based) to track notes and progress

• Submit signed contracts to the Transaction Coordinator for processing

• Follow simple SOPs and scripts

• Build out SoPs and training that mimic your role 

________________________________________

Ideal Candidate:

• 2+ years of experience as a real estate closer (wholesale preferred)

• Strong sales skills with a proven track record of converting leads into contracts

• Confident, clear communicator who can build trust quickly

• Highly organized and able to work independently

• Familiar with tools like GHL, Zoom, and Google Workspace

• Self-motivated and comfortable working commission-only

• U.S. or fluent English speaker who can work during U.S. business hours

________________________________________

Compensation:

• First 2 weeks paid hourly. Commission after that.

• Introductory hourly + Commission – paid per signed contract

• Opportunity to grow with us into a full-time, high-volume closer role

• Bonuses available for high performance and fast-closes

• Part time to full time opportunity

________________________________________

How to Apply:

Please submit the following:

• A short intro explaining your closing experience

• Any KPIs, metrics, or results you’ve hit in past roles

________________________________________

This is a high-opportunity role for someone who’s ready to lock in contracts with confidence. If you're the kind of person who thrives in high-trust conversations and knows how to get deals signed—we want to hear from you.



***Include a voice recording in your submission***

title: Microsoft/Bing Ads Specialist
description:

We want someone who understands paid search, can look at an account and identify where money is being wasted, and can confidently make changes that improve lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rate and overall return on ad spend.

• Strong experience specifically with Microsoft Advertising / Bing Ads

• Experience managing real client advertising budgets

• Strong knowledge of Search campaigns

• Solid understanding of conversion tracking

• Experience analysing search terms and negative keywords

• Strong understanding of bidding strategies and match types

• Good verbal and written English
